+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Index top-k for MiniMax-M3 (FlyDSL, gfx950).
+
+One 64-lane workgroup per (row, head) returns the 16 highest-scoring block ids
+in AITER's order, walking the row in windows of STRIPS x 64 blocks.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.flydsl_utils import PRELOAD_HINTS
+
+BLK = 128  # tokens per block
+TOPK = 16
+PREFILL_STRIPS = (4, 8, 16, 20, 26)
+CAP = 64  # candidates one rank pass holds (one per lane)
+IDX_BITS = 13  # block index bits (slots * 64 <= 8192)
+INT_MIN = -(1 << 31)
+KEY_NEG_INF = (0xFF800000 ^ 0x7FFFFFFF) - (1 << 32)  # signed key of -inf (NaN's)
+KEY_POS_INF = 0x7F800000
+
+
+def _s32(v):
+    v &= 0xFFFFFFFF
+    return v - (1 << 32) if v >= 1 << 31 else v
+
+
+def _key(bits):
+    """Signed key in AITER's order; NaNs land above +inf or below -inf."""
+    return bits ^ ((bits >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
+
+
+def _fold_nan(k):
+    return ((k > KEY_POS_INF) | (k < KEY_NEG_INF)).select(fx.Int32(KEY_NEG_INF), k)
+
+
+def _ballot(c):
+    return fx.Int64(fx.rocdl.ballot(T.i64, c))
+
+
+def _popc(m):
+    """Set bits of a wave mask; two 32-bit counts keep the compare scalar."""
+    lo = fx.math.ctpop(m.to(fx.Int32)).to(fx.Int32)
+    hi = fx.math.ctpop((m >> 32).to(fx.Int32)).to(fx.Int32)
+    return fx.Int32(lo) + fx.Int32(hi)
+
+
+def _below(mask, base):
+    """The set bits of ``mask`` below this lane, plus ``base`` (v_mbcnt)."""
+    lo = mask.to(fx.Int32)
+    hi = (mask >> 32).to(fx.Int32)
+    r = fx.rocdl.mbcnt_lo(T.i32, lo.ir_value(), fx.Int32(base).ir_value())
+    return fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.mbcnt_hi(T.i32, hi.ir_value(), r))
+
+
+def _imax(a, b):
+    return (a > b).select(a, b)
+
+
+def _one(c):
+    return c.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+
+
+def _comp(k, i):
+    """(key, index) as one i64 whose signed order is AITER's."""
+    return (k.to(fx.Int64) << 32) | (i.to(fx.Int64) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
+
+
+def compile_topk_prefill(strips: int, *, decode: bool = False):
+    assert strips == 26 if decode else strips in PREFILL_STRIPS
+    STRIPS = strips
+    WIN = STRIPS * 64
+    RANK_BLOCK = 8
+    # Candidates, rank-loop padding, then one discard slot per lane.
+    TRASH = CAP + RANK_BLOCK
+    CAND = TRASH + 64
+    name = f"m3_index_topk_{'decode' if decode else 'prefill'}_indices_w{STRIPS}"
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Shared:
+        cand: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * CAND, 16]
+        sel: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 4 * TOPK, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[64, 1, 1])
+    def kernel(
+        arg_score: fx.Int64,
+        i64_s_head: fx.Int64,
+        i64_s_row: fx.Int64,
+        i32_width: fx.Int32,
+        arg_nvp: fx.Int64,
+        i32_query_len: fx.Int32,
+        arg_topk: fx.Int64,
+        i64_t_head: fx.Int64,
+        i64_t_row: fx.Int64,
+    ):
+        smem = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Shared).peek()
+        n, h = fx.block_idx.x, fx.block_idx.y
+        lane = fx.thread_idx.x
+        n64 = fx.Int32(n).to(fx.Int64)
+        h64 = fx.Int32(h).to(fx.Int64)
+
+        def rsrc(base, nbytes):
+            """Buffer at an i64 base; per-row rebasing keeps offsets small."""
+            return buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                base, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(nbytes)
+            )
+
+        # Reads past the row's width return 0.
+        score_row = arg_score + (h64 * i64_s_head + n64 * i64_s_row) * 4
+        srs = rsrc(score_row, i32_width.to(fx.Int64) * 4)
+
+        def load_window(srs, wbase):
+            return Vec.from_elements(
+                [
+                    fx.Int32(
+                        buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                            srs,
+                            wbase + (j * 64) + lane,
+                            vec_width=1,
+                            dtype=fx.Int32,
+                        )
+                    )
+                    for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS)
+                ],
+                fx.Int32,
+            )
+
+        # The first window is loaded before the row's length is known.
+        bits = load_window(srs, 0)
+
+        def scalar_at(base, idx64, nbytes):
+            return fx.Int32(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(base + idx64 * 4, nbytes),
+                    fx.Int32(0),
+                    vec_width=1,
+                    is_scalar=True,
+                )
+            )
+
+        if const_expr(decode):
+            req = (fx.Int32(n) // i32_query_len).to(fx.Int64)
+            seq = scalar_at(arg_nvp, req, fx.Int64(4))
+            kv0 = seq - i32_query_len + fx.Int32(n) % i32_query_len + 1
+            kv = (kv0 < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), kv0)
+            nblk = (kv + BLK - 1) // BLK
+        else:
+            nblk = scalar_at(arg_nvp, n64, fx.Int64(4))
+        nlive = (nblk < i32_width).select(nblk, i32_width)
+        # Later windows read only the row's live blocks.
+        srs_live = rsrc(score_row, nlive.to(fx.Int64) * 4)
+
+        def view(ptr, n_dw, width):
+            return fx.logical_divide(
+                fx.make_view(fx.recast_iter(fx.Int32, ptr), fx.make_layout(n_dw, 1)),
+                fx.make_layout(width, 1),
+            )
+
+        pairs = view(smem.cand.ptr, 2 * CAND, 2)
+        quads = view(smem.cand.ptr, 2 * CAND, 4)
+        sels = view(smem.sel.ptr, 4 * TOPK, 4)
+        atom64 = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy64b(), fx.Int32)
+        atom128 = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), fx.Int32)
+
+        def lds_put(atom, v, w, vals):
+            r = fx.make_rmem_tensor(fx.make_layout(w, 1), fx.Int32)
+            r.store(Vec.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32))
+            fx.copy(atom, r, v)
+
+        def lds_get(atom, v, w):
+            r = fx.make_rmem_tensor(fx.make_layout(w, 1), fx.Int32)
+            fx.copy(atom, v, r)
+            x = Vec(r.load())
+            return [fx.Int32(x[e]) for e in range_constexpr(w)]
+
+        def put_pair(pos, i, k):
+            lds_put(atom64, fx.slice(pairs, (None, pos)), 2, [i, k])
+
+        def wave_sum(c):
+            """Sum over the wave of a per-lane count in [0, 63]."""
+            t = fx.Int32(0)
+            for b in range_constexpr(6):
+                t = t + (_popc(_ballot((c & (1 << b)) != 0)) << b)
+            return t
+
+        def compact(keys, wbase, base, pred):
+            """Append the keys ``pred`` keeps at ``base`` if they fit below CAP."""
+            oks = [
+                _one(pred(keys[j], wbase + (j * 64) + lane))
+                for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS)
+            ]
+            cnt = oks[0]
+            for j in range_constexpr(1, STRIPS):
+                cnt = cnt + oks[j]
+            pos = fx.Int32(base)
+            end = fx.Int32(base)
+            for b in range_constexpr(6):  # cnt <= 32
+                bm = _ballot((cnt & (1 << b)) != 0)
+                pos = pos + (_below(bm, 0) << b)
+                end = end + (_popc(bm) << b)
+            # On overflow nothing is written; the caller rebuilds the candidates.
+            if end <= CAP:
+                for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS):
+                    put_pair(
+                        (oks[j] != 0).select(pos, TRASH + lane),
+                        wbase + (j * 64) + lane,
+                        keys[j],
+                    )
+                    pos = pos + oks[j]
+            return end
+
+        def exact_cut(keys, wbase):
+            """The window's 16th key v and the index cut ie among the keys tied
+            with it: (k > v) | (k == v & i >= ie) keeps exactly its top 16."""
+            pe = fx.Int32(0)
+            b = fx.Int32(31)
+            while b >= 0:
+                t = (pe | (fx.Int32(1) << b)) ^ INT_MIN
+                c = fx.Int32(0)
+                for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS):
+                    c = c + _one(keys[j] >= t)
+                pe = (wave_sum(c) >= TOPK).select(t ^ INT_MIN, pe)
+                b = b - 1
+            v = pe ^ INT_MIN
+            c = fx.Int32(0)
+            for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS):
+                c = c + _one(keys[j] > v)
+            need = TOPK - wave_sum(c)
+            ie = fx.Int32(0)
+            b = fx.Int32(IDX_BITS - 1)
+            while b >= 0:
+                t = ie | (fx.Int32(1) << b)
+                c = fx.Int32(0)
+                for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS):
+                    c = c + _one((keys[j] == v) & ((wbase + (j * 64) + lane) >= t))
+                ie = (wave_sum(c) >= need).select(t, ie)
+                b = b - 1
+            return v, ie
+
+        def lane_max_bound(m):
+            p = fx.Int32(0)
+            for d in range_constexpr(12):
+                t = p | _s32(1 << (31 - d))
+                count = _popc(_ballot(m >= (t ^ INT_MIN)))
+                p = (count >= TOPK).select(t, p)
+            return p ^ INT_MIN
+
+        def window(bits, wbase, nrun, tprev):
+            """One window of keys merged into the running top 16 (sel)."""
+            keys = []
+            for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS):
+                live = (wbase + (j * 64) + lane) < nlive
+                keys.append(live.select(_key(bits[j]), fx.Int32(INT_MIN)))
+            m = keys[0]
+            for j in range_constexpr(1, STRIPS):
+                m = _imax(m, keys[j])
+            # Bound: the lane maxima in the first window, the running 16th later.
+            tw = fx.Int32(INT_MIN)
+            if nrun < TOPK:
+                tw = lane_max_bound(m)
+            ta = _imax(tw, tprev)
+            total = compact(keys, wbase, nrun, lambda k, i: k >= ta)
+            # Exact only if 16 keys above -inf bound it and no NaN is above +inf.
+            nan_hi = _ballot(m > KEY_POS_INF) != fx.Int64(0)
+            if (total > CAP) | (ta <= KEY_NEG_INF) | nan_hi:
+                wl = nlive - wbase
+                if wl <= CAP - nrun:
+                    # Every live block of the window is a candidate.
+                    put_pair(
+                        (lane < wl).select(nrun + lane, TRASH + lane),
+                        wbase + lane,
+                        _fold_nan(keys[0]),
+                    )
+                    total = nrun + wl
+                else:
+                    # NaNs to -inf and re-bound; exact search if still too many.
+                    fixed = []
+                    for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS):
+                        live = (wbase + (j * 64) + lane) < nlive
+                        fixed.append(live.select(_fold_nan(keys[j]), fx.Int32(INT_MIN)))
+                    mf = fixed[0]
+                    for j in range_constexpr(1, STRIPS):
+                        mf = _imax(mf, fixed[j])
+                    tf = _imax(lane_max_bound(mf), tprev)
+                    total = compact(fixed, wbase, nrun, lambda k, i: k >= tf)
+                    if total > CAP:
+                        v, ie = exact_cut(fixed, wbase)
+                        total = compact(
+                            fixed,
+                            wbase,
+                            nrun,
+                            lambda k, i: (k > v) | ((k == v) & (i >= ie)),
+                        )
+            if lane < RANK_BLOCK:
+                put_pair(total + lane, fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(INT_MIN))
+            fx.gpu.barrier()
+            mi, mk = lds_get(atom64, fx.slice(pairs, (None, lane)), 2)
+            mw = _comp(mk, mi)
+            rank = fx.Int32(0)
+            for g in range_constexpr(CAP // RANK_BLOCK):
+                if total > RANK_BLOCK * g:
+                    es = [
+                        lds_get(
+                            atom128, fx.slice(quads, (None, RANK_BLOCK // 2 * g + u)), 4
+                        )
+                        for u in range_constexpr(RANK_BLOCK // 2)
+                    ]
+                    # All of a block's reads in flight before the compares.
+                    fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+                    for e in es:
+                        rank = rank + _one(_comp(e[1], e[0]) > mw)
+                        rank = rank + _one(_comp(e[3], e[2]) > mw)
+            if (lane < total) & (rank < TOPK):
+                lds_put(atom128, fx.slice(sels, (None, rank)), 4, [mi, mk, 0, mi])
+            return (total < TOPK).select(total, fx.Int32(TOPK))
+
+        wbase = fx.Int32(0)
+        nrun = fx.Int32(0)
+        tprev = fx.Int32(INT_MIN + 1)  # dead keys are INT_MIN
+        while (wbase == 0) | (wbase < nlive):
+            if wbase > 0:
+                bits = load_window(srs_live, wbase)
+                # The running top 16 back into cand; its 16th key bounds the window.
+                fx.gpu.barrier()
+                r = lds_get(atom128, fx.slice(sels, (None, lane & (TOPK - 1))), 4)
+                if lane < nrun:
+                    put_pair(lane, r[0], r[1])
+                k15 = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, r[1], fx.Int32(TOPK - 1)))
+                tprev = (nrun >= TOPK).select(k15, fx.Int32(INT_MIN + 1))
+                fx.gpu.barrier()
+            nrun = window(
+                [fx.Int32(bits[j]) for j in range_constexpr(STRIPS)],
+                wbase,
+                nrun,
+                tprev,
+            )
+            wbase = wbase + WIN
+
+        fx.gpu.barrier()
+        r = lds_get(atom128, fx.slice(sels, (None, lane & (TOPK - 1))), 4)
+        blk = (lane < nrun).select(r[0], fx.Int32(-1))
+        buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+            blk,
+            rsrc(arg_topk + (h64 * i64_t_head + n64 * i64_t_row) * 4, TOPK * 4),
+            lane,
+            mask=lane < TOPK,
+        )
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        arg_score: fx.Int64,
+        i64_s_head: fx.Int64,
+        i64_s_row: fx.Int64,
+        i32_width: fx.Int32,
+        arg_nvp: fx.Int64,
+        i32_query_len: fx.Int32,
+        arg_topk: fx.Int64,
+        i64_t_head: fx.Int64,
+        i64_t_row: fx.Int64,
+        i32_rows: fx.Int32,
+        i32_heads: fx.Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream,
+    ):
+        kernel(
+            arg_score,
+            i64_s_head,
+            i64_s_row,
+            i32_width,
+            arg_nvp,
+            i32_query_len,
+            arg_topk,
+            i64_t_head,
+            i64_t_row,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(fx.Int64(i32_rows), fx.Int64(i32_heads), 1),
+            block=(64, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+
+    launch.kernel_name = name
+    launch.compile_hints = PRELOAD_HINTS
+    return launch

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Launch wrapper of the fused norm / RoPE / NVFP4 insert."""
+
+import functools
+import struct
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.flydsl_utils import (
+    run_compiled,
+)
+
+from . import kernel as _kernel
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _get_kernel(nq: int, nkv: int, niq: int, rotary_dim: int, tp: int):
+    return _kernel.compile_norm_rope_insert(nq, nkv, niq, rotary_dim, tp)
+
+
+def _token_pairs_per_wave(n: int) -> int:
+    return 1 if n <= 512 else 4
+
+
+def minimax_m3_norm_rope_nvfp4_insert(
+    qkv: torch.Tensor,  # [n, (nq + 2 nkv + niq + 1) * 128] bf16
+    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    index_q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    index_k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [max_pos, rotary_dim] bf16
+    positions: torch.Tensor,  # [n] int64
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor,  # [n] int64, -1 skips the token
+    index_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor,  # [n] int64, -1 skips the token
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [blocks, 2 nkv, 128, 72] uint8
+    index_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [blocks, 128, 72] uint8
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,  # fp32 global scales
+    v_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    q_out: torch.Tensor,  # [n, nq * 128] bf16
+    index_q_out: torch.Tensor,  # [n, niq * 128] e4m3, row stride free
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    num_index_heads: int,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    """Norm + RoPE of q / k / index-q / index-k and the NVFP4 K/V and index-K
+    inserts in one launch; k and index-k are not written back into ``qkv``."""
+    n = qkv.shape[0]
+    if n == 0:
+        return
+    nq, nkv, niq = num_heads, num_kv_heads, num_index_heads
+    rotary_dim = cos_sin_cache.shape[1]
+    assert eps >= 2.0**-126  # the kernel's rsqrt skips ocml's denormal scaling
+    assert qkv.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and qkv.is_contiguous()
+    assert qkv.shape[1] == (nq + 2 * nkv + niq + 1) * _kernel.D
+    assert cos_sin_cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and cos_sin_cache.is_contiguous()
+    for w in (q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight, index_q_norm_weight, index_k_norm_weight):
+        assert w.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and w.is_contiguous()
+    assert q_out.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and q_out.is_contiguous()
+    assert index_q_out.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn and index_q_out.stride(1) == 1
+    assert index_q_out.stride(0) % 4 == 0
+    assert kv_cache.shape[1:] == (2 * nkv, _kernel.BLK, 72)
+    assert kv_cache.stride(1) == _kernel.BLK * 72 and kv_cache.stride(3) == 1
+    assert index_cache.shape[1:] == (_kernel.BLK, 72) and index_cache.stride(2) == 1
+    assert index_cache.stride(1) == 72
+    run_compiled(
+        _get_kernel(nq, nkv, niq, rotary_dim, _token_pairs_per_wave(n)),
+        qkv.data_ptr(),
+        q_out.data_ptr(),
+        index_q_out.data_ptr(),
+        q_norm_weight.data_ptr(),
+        k_norm_weight.data_ptr(),
+        index_q_norm_weight.data_ptr(),
+        index_k_norm_weight.data_ptr(),
+        cos_sin_cache.data_ptr(),
+        positions.data_ptr(),
+        slot_mapping.data_ptr(),
+        index_slot_mapping.data_ptr(),
+        kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+        index_cache.data_ptr(),
+        k_scale.data_ptr(),
+        v_scale.data_ptr(),
+        n,
+        index_q_out.stride(0),
+        kv_cache.stride(0),
+        index_cache.stride(0),
+        cos_sin_cache.shape[0],
+        struct.unpack("<i", struct.pack("<f", eps))[0],
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Gemma norm + RoPE of q / k / index-q / index-k and the NVFP4 K/V + index-K
+page inserts in one launch (FlyDSL, gfx950), bit for bit the ROCm
+``fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert`` followed by the NVFP4 page insert.
+
+Waves of 2 * tp tokens: [q heads | k heads | index-k | index-q heads | v heads x tp];
+a norm wave holds 4 dims of a token per lane (the HIP kernel's lane map).
+"""
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _arith
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.flydsl_utils import (
+    PRELOAD_HINTS,
+    as_f32,
+    bits,
+    permlane_swap,
+    pk_bf16,
+)
+
+NW = 4
+D = 128
+BLK = 128  # tokens per NVFP4 page
+RCP6 = 0x3E2AAAAB  # RN(1 / 6)
+F448 = 0x43E00000
+F448N = 0xC3E00000 - (1 << 32)
+
+
+def _bf16x4(v):
+    """4 fp32 of a dword pair of bf16 (low half first)."""
+    w0, w1 = fx.Int32(v[0]), fx.Int32(v[1])
+    return [
+        (w0 << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32),
+        (w0 & -65536).bitcast(fx.Float32),
+        (w1 << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32),
+        (w1 & -65536).bitcast(fx.Float32),
+    ]
+
+
+def _norm_rope_out4(xws_t, css_t, w, eps, hi16, first, in_rope, half4):
+    """Norm + RoPE of one token's 4 dims in this lane -> 4 fp32."""
+    cos, sin = css_t
+    e = _bf16x4(xws_t)
+    ss = e[0] * e[0] + e[1] * e[1]
+    ss = ss + e[2] * e[2]
+    ss = ss + e[3] * e[3]
+    for m in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
+        ss = _xsum(ss, m)
+    r = _rsq(fx.math.fma(ss, fx.Float32(0.0078125), eps))
+    nrm = [(e[i] * r) * (fx.Float32(1.0) + w[i]) for i in range_constexpr(4)]
+    out = []
+    for i in range_constexpr(4):
+        pr = _xor_lane(bits(nrm[i]), half4, hi16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+        ps = pr * sin[i]
+        roped = fx.math.fma(nrm[i], cos[i], first.select(-ps, ps))
+        out.append(in_rope.select(roped, nrm[i]))
+    return out
+
+
+def _maxnum(a, b):
+    return fx.Float32(_arith.MaxNumFOp(fx.as_ir_value(a), fx.as_ir_value(b)).result)
+
+
+def _minnum(a, b):
+    return fx.Float32(_arith.MinNumFOp(fx.as_ir_value(a), fx.as_ir_value(b)).result)
+
+
+def _dpp(src, ctrl, old=None, bank_mask=0xF):
+    """v_mov_b32_dpp; an undef ``old`` lets the move fold into its consumer."""
+    o = _llvm.mlir_undef(T.i32) if old is None else fx.as_ir_value(old)
+    full = old is None and bank_mask == 0xF
+    return fx.Int32(
+        fx.rocdl.update_dpp(T.i32, o, fx.as_ir_value(src), ctrl, 0xF, bank_mask, full)
+    )
+
+
+def _swap16(v):
+    """permlane16_swap(v, v): (own, lane ^ 16) in rows 0 / 2, swapped in 1 / 3."""
+    return permlane_swap(fx.rocdl.permlane16_swap, v, v)
+
+
+def _xor_lane(v, m, hi16):
+    """Lane l ^ m of the 32-lane half; ``hi16`` is this lane's bit 4."""
+    if m == 1:
+        return _dpp(v, 0xB1)  # quad_perm [1, 0, 3, 2]
+    if m == 2:
+        return _dpp(v, 0x4E)  # quad_perm [2, 3, 0, 1]
+    if m == 4:  # row_shr:4 into banks 1, 3, then row_shl:4 into banks 0, 2
+        return _dpp(v, 0x104, old=_dpp(v, 0x114, bank_mask=0xA), bank_mask=0x5)
+    if m == 8:
+        return _dpp(v, 0x128)  # row_ror:8
+    assert m == 16
+    a, b = _swap16(v)
+    return hi16.select(a, b)
+
+
+def _xsum(x, m):
+    """Adds lane l ^ m's value to ``x``."""
+    if m == 16:
+        a, b = _swap16(bits(x))
+        return a.bitcast(fx.Float32) + b.bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    return x + _xor_lane(bits(x), m, None).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def _xmax(x, m):
+    return _maxnum(x, _xor_lane(bits(x), m, None).bitcast(fx.Float32))
+
+
+def _rsq(x):
+    """v_rsq_f32; ocml's denormal scaling never applies as x >= eps >= 2^-126."""
+    return fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.rsq(T.f32, fx.as_ir_value(x)))
+
+
+def _e4m3_byte(x):
+    """RNE e4m3 byte of ``x``."""
+    pk = fx.rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp8_f32(
+        T.vec(2, T.i16),
+        fx.as_ir_value(Vec.filled(2, 0, fx.Int16)),
+        fx.as_ir_value(x),
+        fx.as_ir_value(x),
+        fx.as_ir_value(fx.Float32(1.0)),
+        False,
+    )
+    return Vec(pk).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0] & 0xFF
+
+
+def _e4m3_value(byte):
+    pk = fx.rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_f32_fp8(
+        T.vec(2, T.f32),
+        fx.as_ir_value(fx.Int32(byte)),
+        fx.as_ir_value(fx.Float32(1.0)),
+        False,
+    )
+    return fx.Float32(Vec(pk)[0])
+
+
+def _iq_fp8(a, b, old, hi):
+    """Two fp32 -> e4m3 bytes in the low (``hi``: high) half of ``old``."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        fx.rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(
+            T.i32,
+            fx.as_ir_value(fx.Float32(a)),
+            fx.as_ir_value(fx.Float32(b)),
+            fx.as_ir_value(fx.Int32(old)),
+            hi,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _e2m1x2(a, b, old, sel):
+    """E2M1 codes of ``a``, ``b`` into byte ``sel`` of ``old``, ``a`` low."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        fx.rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp4_f32(
+            T.i32,
+            fx.as_ir_value(fx.Int32(old)),
+            fx.as_ir_value(a),
+            fx.as_ir_value(b),
+            fx.as_ir_value(fx.Float32(1.0)),
+            sel,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _quant4(xs, gs, inv_gs):
+    """E2M1 codes of this lane's 4 values (16 bits) and the e4m3 scale byte of
+    their 16-value group (lanes l ^ 0..3)."""
+    a = [fx.math.absf(x) for x in xs]
+    m = _maxnum(_maxnum(a[0], a[1]), _maxnum(a[2], a[3]))
+    m = _xmax(_xmax(m, 1), 2)
+    sf = _minnum((m * as_f32(RCP6)) * inv_gs, as_f32(F448))
+    byte = _e4m3_byte(sf)
+    sv = _e4m3_value(byte)
+    quant = (sv != 0.0).select(fx.Float32(1.0) / (gs * sv), fx.Float32(0.0))
+    y = [x * quant for x in xs]
+    return _e2m1x2(y[2], y[3], _e2m1x2(y[0], y[1], fx.Int32(0), 0), 1), byte
+
+
+def _v_row(state, row, r, n_run, p0, vs, inv_vs):
+    """Adds row ``r`` of a V run at octet positions p0.. to ``state``: new
+    nibbles and scale bytes, with their masks."""
+    words, written = state[0:4], state[4]
+    sc, sc_mask = state[5:7], state[7:9]
+    nib, sf = _quant4(_bf16x4(row), vs, inv_vs)
+    in_run = n_run > r
+    p = p0 + r
+    sh = p * 4
+    words = [
+        wd | in_run.select(((nib >> (4 * i)) & 15) << sh, fx.Int32(0))
+        for i, wd in enumerate(words)
+    ]
+    written = written | in_run.select(fx.Int32(15) << sh, fx.Int32(0))
+    bsh = (p % 4) * 8
+    for k in range_constexpr(2):
+        here = in_run & ((p // 4) == k)
+        sc[k] = sc[k] | here.select(sf << bsh, fx.Int32(0))
+        sc_mask[k] = sc_mask[k] | here.select(fx.Int32(255) << bsh, fx.Int32(0))
+    return [*words, written, *sc, *sc_mask]
+
+
+def _gptr(addr, ty, align):
+    return fx.inttoptr(
+        fx.PointerType.get(ty, address_space=fx.AddressSpace.Global, alignment=align),
+        fx.Int64(addr),
+    )
+
+
+def _k_scale_off(tok, grp):
+    """Byte of (token, group) in a head's K scale region."""
+    r = tok % 32
+    n = (r // 8) * 4 + r % 4
+    return ((((tok // 32) * 4 + grp // 2) * 16 + n) * 2 + (r % 8) // 4) * 2 + grp % 2
+
+
+def compile_norm_rope_insert(nq: int, nkv: int, niq: int, rotary_dim: int, tp: int):
+    """Build the kernel; ``tp`` token pairs per norm / RoPE wave, one per V wave."""
+    assert rotary_dim in (8, 16, 32, 64, 128)
+    NR = nq + nkv + 1 + niq  # norm + RoPE waves
+    S = NR + nkv * tp  # waves per 2 * tp tokens
+    ROW = (nq + 2 * nkv + niq + 1) * D
+    HALF = rotary_dim // 2
+    SIDE = nkv * BLK * 72  # bytes of one side of a main page
+    TPW = 2 * tp
+    name = f"m3_norm_rope_nvfp4_insert_q{nq}_kv{nkv}_iq{niq}_r{rotary_dim}_t{tp}"
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[64 * NW, 1, 1])
+    def kernel(
+        i32_n: fx.Int32,
+        i32_cs_rows: fx.Int32,
+        arg_qkv: fx.Int64,  # [n, ROW] bf16
+        arg_pos: fx.Int64,  # positions [n] i64
+        arg_slot: fx.Int64,  # main slots [n] i64, -1 skips
+        arg_islot: fx.Int64,  # index slots [n] i64, -1 skips
+        arg_cs: fx.Int64,  # cos_sin_cache [i32_cs_rows, rotary_dim] bf16
+        arg_qw: fx.Int64,  # norm weights [128] bf16: q, k, index-q, index-k
+        arg_kw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_iqw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_ikw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q: fx.Int64,  # q_out [n, nq * 128] bf16
+        arg_iq: fx.Int64,  # index_q_out [n, niq * 128] e4m3, row stride i32_iq_st
+        arg_kv: fx.Int64,  # [blocks, 2 * nkv, 128, 72] u8
+        arg_idx: fx.Int64,  # [blocks, 128, 72] u8
+        arg_ks: fx.Int64,  # fp32 global scales
+        arg_vs: fx.Int64,
+        i64_kv_st: fx.Int64,
+        i64_idx_st: fx.Int64,
+        i32_iq_st: fx.Int32,
+        i32_eps: fx.Int32,  # fp32 bits
+    ):
+        tx, bx = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        lane = tx % 64
+        wave = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, tx // 64))
+        wid = bx * NW + wave
+        s = wid % S
+        hl = lane % 32
+        hi16 = (hl & 16) != 0
+        dim0 = hl * 4
+        toks = [(wid // S) * TPW + t * 2 + lane // 32 for t in range_constexpr(tp)]
+        lives = [tk < i32_n for tk in toks]
+
+        qkv = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_qkv, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_n) * (ROW * 2)
+        )
+        sl_r = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_slot, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_n) * 8
+        )
+
+        if s < NR:
+            is_q = s < nq
+            is_k = (s >= nq) & (s < nq + nkv)
+            is_ik = s == nq + nkv
+            is_kq = is_k | is_ik
+            # This wave's head column in the qkv row.
+            col = (s <= nq + nkv).select(
+                is_ik.select(fx.Int32(nq + 2 * nkv + niq), s),
+                s - (nq + nkv + 1) + (nq + 2 * nkv),
+            )
+            w_addr = is_q.select(
+                arg_qw, is_k.select(arg_kw, is_ik.select(arg_ikw, arg_iqw))
+            )
+            wr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                w_addr, num_records_bytes=D * 2
+            )
+            pos_r = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                arg_pos, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_n) * 8
+            )
+            isl_r = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                arg_islot, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_n) * 8
+            )
+            cs_r = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                arg_cs, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_cs_rows) * (rotary_dim * 2)
+            )
+            xws, poss, slots = [], [], []
+            for t in range_constexpr(tp):
+                xws.append(
+                    Vec(
+                        buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                            qkv,
+                            toks[t] * (ROW // 2) + col * (D // 2) + hl * 2,
+                            vec_width=2,
+                            dtype=fx.Int32,
+                            mask=lives[t],
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+                poss.append(
+                    fx.Int32(
+                        buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                            pos_r,
+                            toks[t] * 2,
+                            vec_width=1,
+                            dtype=fx.Int32,
+                            mask=lives[t],
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+                kslot = fx.Int32(
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        sl_r,
+                        toks[t] * 2,
+                        vec_width=1,
+                        dtype=fx.Int32,
+                        mask=lives[t] & is_k,
+                    )
+                )
+                islot = fx.Int32(
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        isl_r,
+                        toks[t] * 2,
+                        vec_width=1,
+                        dtype=fx.Int32,
+                        mask=lives[t] & is_ik,
+                    )
+                )
+                slots.append(is_k.select(kslot, islot))
+            w = _bf16x4(
+                Vec(buffer_ops.buffer_load(wr, hl * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=fx.Int32))
+            )
+            first = dim0 < HALF
+            in_rope = dim0 < rotary_dim
+            ib = first.select(dim0, dim0 - HALF)
+            css = []
+            for t in range_constexpr(tp):
+                cs_off = (poss[t] * rotary_dim + ib) // 2
+                css.append(
+                    (
+                        _bf16x4(
+                            Vec(
+                                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                                    cs_r,
+                                    cs_off,
+                                    vec_width=2,
+                                    dtype=fx.Int32,
+                                    mask=lives[t] & in_rope,
+                                )
+                            )
+                        ),
+                        _bf16x4(
+                            Vec(
+                                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                                    cs_r,
+                                    cs_off + HALF // 2,
+                                    vec_width=2,
+                                    dtype=fx.Int32,
+                                    mask=lives[t] & in_rope,
+                                )
+                            )
+                        ),
+                    )
+                )
+            eps = i32_eps.bitcast(fx.Float32)
+            qvs = []
+            for t in range_constexpr(tp):
+                out = _norm_rope_out4(
+                    xws[t], css[t], w, eps, hi16, first, in_rope, HALF // 4
+                )
+                lo, hi = pk_bf16(out[0], out[1]), pk_bf16(out[2], out[3])
+                qvs.append(Vec.from_elements([lo, hi], fx.Int32))
+            if is_q:
+                q_r = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                    arg_q, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_n) * (nq * D * 2)
+                )
+                for t in range_constexpr(tp):
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+                        qvs[t],
+                        q_r,
+                        toks[t] * (nq * D // 2) + s * (D // 2) + hl * 2,
+                        mask=lives[t],

+                    arg_iq, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_n) * fx.Int64(i32_iq_st)
+                )
+                iq_col = (s - (nq + nkv + 1)) * D
+                for t in range_constexpr(tp):
+                    f = [
+                        _minnum(_maxnum(x, as_f32(F448N)), as_f32(F448))
+                        for x in _bf16x4(qvs[t])
+                    ]
+                    word = _iq_fp8(
+                        f[2], f[3], _iq_fp8(f[0], f[1], fx.Int32(0), False), True
+                    )
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+                        word,
+                        iq_r,
+                        toks[t] * i32_iq_st + iq_col + dim0,
+                        mask=lives[t],
+                        offset_is_bytes=True,

+            if is_kq:
+                gs = is_k.select(
+                    fx.Float32(_gptr(arg_ks, T.f32, 4)[0]), fx.Float32(1.0)
+                )
+                inv_gs = fx.Float32(1.0) / gs
+                quants = [
+                    _quant4(_bf16x4(qvs[t]), gs, inv_gs) for t in range_constexpr(tp)
+                ]
+                h = s - nq
+                grp = hl // 4
+                for t in range_constexpr(tp):
+                    slot = slots[t]
+                    tp_ = slot & (BLK - 1)
+                    page = is_k.select(
+                        arg_kv + fx.Int64(slot >> 7) * i64_kv_st,
+                        arg_idx + fx.Int64(slot >> 7) * i64_idx_st,
+                    )
+                    d_off = is_k.select(h * (BLK * 64), fx.Int32(0)) + tp_ * 64 + hl * 2
+                    s_off = is_k.select(
+                        nkv * BLK * 64 + h * (BLK * 8) + _k_scale_off(tp_, grp),
+                        BLK * 64 + tp_ * 8 + grp,

+                    s_ptr = _gptr(page + fx.Int64(s_off), T.i8, 1)

+                    sf8 = quants[t][1].to(fx.Int8)

+                        if hl % 4 == 0:

+            tok = (wid // S) * TPW + ((s - NR) % tp) * 2 + lane // 32
+            live = tok < i32_n
+            vcol = (nq + nkv + vh) * (D // 2)  # V head column (dwords)
+            vs = fx.Float32(_gptr(arg_vs, T.f32, 4)[0])
+            near_t = tok - 7 + hl
+            has_near = (hl < 16) & (near_t >= 0) & (near_t < i32_n)
+            near = has_near.select(
+                fx.Int32(
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        sl_r, near_t * 2, vec_width=1, dtype=fx.Int32, mask=has_near
+                    )
+                ),
+                fx.Int32(-1),
+            )
+            slot = fx.Int32(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    sl_r, tok * 2, vec_width=1, dtype=fx.Int32, mask=live
+                )
+            )
+            has_prev = live & (tok > 0)
+            prev = has_prev.select(
+                fx.Int32(
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        sl_r, tok * 2 - 2, vec_width=1, dtype=fx.Int32, mask=has_prev
+                    )
+                ),
+                fx.Int32(-1),
+            )
+            # The first token of a run in one 8-token octet writes the run and
+            # keeps the octet's other nibbles and scales. Rows it can cover load
+            # before its slot is known.
+            rows = [
+                Vec(
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        qkv,
+                        (tok + r) * (ROW // 2) + vcol + hl * 2,
+                        vec_width=2,
+                        dtype=fx.Int32,
+                        mask=tok + r < i32_n,
+                    )
+                )
+                for r in range_constexpr(8)
+            ]
+            base = slot - slot % 8
+            in_oct = (near >= base) & (near < base + 8)
+            votes = fx.Int64(fx.rocdl.ballot(T.i64, in_oct))
+            mine = (votes >> fx.Int64((lane // 32) * 32)).to(fx.Int32) & 0xFFFF
+            n_run = fx.Int32(fx.math.ctpop(mine))
+            run_first = (prev < 0) | ((prev >> 3) != (slot >> 3))
+            tp_ = slot & (BLK - 1)
+            v_side = arg_kv + fx.Int64(slot >> 7) * i64_kv_st + SIDE
+            v_data = v_side + fx.Int64(vh * (BLK * 64) + (tp_ // 8) * (D * 4))
+            v_sf = v_side + fx.Int64(nkv * BLK * 64 + vh * (BLK * 8) + tp_ - tp_ % 8)
+            dp = _gptr(v_data + fx.Int64(dim0 * 4), T.i32, 4)
+            sp = _gptr(v_sf + fx.Int64((hl // 4) * BLK), T.i32, 4)
+            go = live & (slot >= 0) & run_first
+            inv_vs = fx.Float32(1.0) / vs
+            # Runs of <= 4 tokens (decode) take the short tile.
+            for run_rows, take in (
+                (rows[:4], go & (n_run <= 4)),
+                (rows, go & (n_run > 4)),
+            ):
+                if take:
+                    old = [fx.Int32(dp[i]) for i in range_constexpr(4)]
+                    old_sc = [fx.Int32(sp[i]) for i in range_constexpr(2)]
+                    st = [fx.Int32(0)] * 9
+                    for r in range_constexpr(len(run_rows)):
+                        st = _v_row(st, run_rows[r], r, n_run, tp_ % 8, vs, inv_vs)
+                    keep = ~st[4]
+                    for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                        dp[i] = st[i] | (old[i] & keep)
+                    sc0 = st[5] | (old_sc[0] & ~st[7])
+                    sc1 = st[6] | (old_sc[1] & ~st[8])
+                    if hl % 4 == 0:
+                        sp[0] = sc0
+                        sp[1] = sc1
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        arg_qkv: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q: fx.Int64,
+        arg_iq: fx.Int64,
+        arg_qw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_kw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_iqw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_ikw: fx.Int64,
+        arg_cs: fx.Int64,
+        arg_pos: fx.Int64,
+        arg_slot: fx.Int64,
+        arg_islot: fx.Int64,
+        arg_kv: fx.Int64,
+        arg_idx: fx.Int64,
+        arg_ks: fx.Int64,
+        arg_vs: fx.Int64,
+        i32_n: fx.Int32,
+        i32_iq_st: fx.Int32,
+        i64_kv_st: fx.Int64,
+        i64_idx_st: fx.Int64,
+        i32_cs_rows: fx.Int32,
+        i32_eps: fx.Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream,
+    ):
+        waves = (i32_n + (TPW - 1)) // TPW * S
+        kernel(
+            i32_n,
+            i32_cs_rows,
+            arg_qkv,
+            arg_pos,
+            arg_slot,
+            arg_islot,
+            arg_cs,
+            arg_qw,
+            arg_kw,
+            arg_iqw,
+            arg_ikw,
+            arg_q,
+            arg_iq,
+            arg_kv,
+            arg_idx,
+            arg_ks,
+            arg_vs,
+            i64_kv_st,
+            i64_idx_st,
+            i32_iq_st,
+            i32_eps,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(fx.Int64((waves + (NW - 1)) // NW), 1, 1),
+            block=(64 * NW, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+
+    launch.kernel_name = name
+    launch.compile_hints = PRELOAD_HINTS
+    return launch

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Launch wrappers of the FlyDSL NVFP4 decode index scorers."""
+
+import functools
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.flydsl_utils import run_compiled
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.nvfp4_index_prefill.host import nvfp4_e4m3_lut
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+
+from . import kernel as _kernel
+
+# 158 VGPRs = 3 waves per SIMD; more waves add a second round of workgroups.
+TARGET_WAVES = 3072
+# Scores are buffered in LDS and stored by whole rows once the batch's score
+# footprint reaches this; smaller footprints store directly.
+BUFFER_MIN_BYTES = 8 << 20
+UNITS_PER_SLOT = 4
+
+
+def _end_bytes(t: torch.Tensor) -> int:
+    """Bytes from the data pointer to the end of the last element."""
+    return (
+        sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(t.shape, t.stride())) + 1
+    ) * t.element_size()
+
+
+def _unit(max_blocks: int, slots: int, umax: int, footprint: int) -> int:
+    """Consecutive blocks per buffered unit (a power of two, 4..umax) giving
+    every wave slot >= UNITS_PER_SLOT units, or 0 for direct stores."""
+    if footprint < BUFFER_MIN_BYTES:
+        return 0
+    u = umax
+    while u > 4 and cdiv(max_blocks, u) < UNITS_PER_SLOT * slots:
+        u //= 2
+    return u if cdiv(max_blocks, u) >= UNITS_PER_SLOT * slots else 0
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _get_kernel(rows: int, heads: int, buffered: bool):
+    return _kernel.compile_score_decode(rows, heads, buffered)
+
+
+def _supported(
+    q_idx: torch.Tensor,
+    index_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    score: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    query_len: int,
+) -> bool:
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    num_heads = q_idx.shape[1]
+    return (
+        on_gfx950()
+        and num_heads in (1, 2, 4)
+        and 1 <= num_heads * query_len <= _kernel.MAX_ROWS
+        and q_idx.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        and q_idx.shape[2] == _kernel.D
+        and q_idx.stride(2) == 1
+        and q_idx.stride(0) % 16 == 0
+        and q_idx.stride(1) % 16 == 0
+        and q_idx.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        and index_cache.dtype == torch.uint8
+        and index_cache.stride(2) == 1
+        and index_cache.stride(1) == _kernel.D // 2 + _kernel.D // 16
+        and index_cache.stride(0) % 16 == 0
+        and index_cache.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        and score.dtype == torch.float32
+        and score.stride(2) == 1
+        and block_table.dtype == torch.int32
+        and block_table.stride(1) == 1
+        and seq_lens.dtype == torch.int32
+        and seq_lens.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
+def minimax_m3_nvfp4_index_score_decode(
+    q_idx: torch.Tensor,  # [num_reqs * query_len, H, 128] e4m3
+    index_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [num_blocks, 128, 72] uint8
+    score: torch.Tensor,  # [H, num_reqs * query_len, >= max_blocks] fp32
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,  # [num_reqs, >= max_blocks] int32
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,  # [num_reqs] int32
+    init_blocks: int,
+    local_blocks: int,
+    query_len: int,
+    max_seq_len: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Block scores of every decode row for blocks below cdiv(seq_len, 128)."""
+    total_q, num_heads, _ = q_idx.shape
+    num_reqs = total_q // query_len
+    if num_reqs == 0:
+        return
+    assert _supported(q_idx, index_cache, score, block_table, seq_lens, query_len)
+    rows = num_heads * query_len
+    max_blocks = max(1, cdiv(max_seq_len, _kernel.BLK))
+    # A chunk of NW x (pages per wave) requests; with at most one page per
+    # wave, chunks of one request and each wave on its own positions.
+    pages_per_wave = cdiv(num_reqs * max_blocks, TARGET_WAVES)
+    s_bytes = _end_bytes(score)
+    assert s_bytes < 2**31 * 4, "score offsets must fit in int32 elements"
+    footprint = num_reqs * rows * max_blocks * 4
+    chunk = 1 if pages_per_wave <= 1 else _kernel.NW * pages_per_wave
+    chunk_cap = _kernel.chunk_max(_kernel.padded_rows(rows))
+    chunk = max(1, min(chunk, chunk_cap, num_reqs))
+    nch = cdiv(num_reqs, chunk)
+    chunk = cdiv(num_reqs, nch)
+    per_wave = chunk < _kernel.NW
+    wanted = max(1, TARGET_WAVES // (_kernel.NW * nch))
+    # Past 16 rows the buffered variant's flush costs more than it saves.
+    unit = (
+        _unit(
+            max_blocks,
+            wanted * (_kernel.NW if per_wave else 1),
+            _kernel.UMAX,
+            footprint,
+        )
+        if _kernel.padded_rows(rows) <= 16
+        else 0
+    )
+    units = cdiv(max_blocks, max(1, unit))
+    positions = cdiv(units, _kernel.NW) if per_wave else units
+    splits = max(1, min(positions, wanted))
+    run_compiled(
+        _get_kernel(rows, num_heads, unit > 0),
+        q_idx.data_ptr(),
+        index_cache.data_ptr(),
+        nvfp4_e4m3_lut(q_idx.device).data_ptr(),
+        score.data_ptr(),
+        block_table.data_ptr(),
+        seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+        int(index_cache.stride(0)),
+        int(q_idx.stride(0)),
+        int(q_idx.stride(1)),
+        _end_bytes(q_idx),
+        int(score.stride(0)),
+        int(score.stride(1)),
+        s_bytes,
+        int(block_table.stride(0)),
+        _end_bytes(block_table),
+        int(num_reqs),
+        int(chunk),
+        int(nch),
+        int(splits),
+        int(init_blocks),
+        int(local_blocks),
+        int(per_wave),
+        int(unit),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        # Keep the buffered variant at the plain one's occupancy.
+        waves_per_eu=3 if unit > 0 and _kernel.padded_rows(rows) <= 16 else None,
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _get_kernel_cp_push():
+    from . import kernel_cp_push
+
+    return kernel_cp_push.compile_score_push()
+
+
+def minimax_m3_nvfp4_index_score_push_cp(
+    iq: torch.Tensor,  # this rank's index head [num_reqs * 4, 128] e4m3
+    index_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [num_blocks, 128, 72] uint8
+    dests: list[int],  # head h's scores [rows, row_stride] fp32 on rank h
+    row_stride: int,
+    dest_bytes: int,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,  # [num_reqs, >= max_blocks] int32
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,  # [num_reqs] int32
+    init_blocks: int,
+    local_blocks: int,
+    rank: int,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,  # index_cp's device counters
+    flags: list[int],  # rank p's flag words
+    iq_bufs: list[int],  # rank p's index-q receive buffer [4, iq_rows, 128] e4m3
+    iq_rows: int,
+    grid: int = 0,
+) -> None:
+    """This rank's share of all four heads' decode scores, pushed to the heads'
+    ranks; returns once every rank's scores have arrived."""
+    from . import kernel_cp_push
+
+    rows = iq.shape[0]
+    assert rows % 4 == 0 and rows <= iq_rows
+    assert iq.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn and iq.shape[1] == kernel_cp_push.D
+    assert iq.stride(1) == 1 and iq.stride(0) == kernel_cp_push.D
+    num_reqs = rows // 4
+    assert num_reqs <= kernel_cp_push.MAX_REQS
+    if not grid:
+        small = num_reqs <= kernel_cp_push.GRID_SMALL_REQS
+        grid = kernel_cp_push.GRID_SMALL if small else kernel_cp_push.GRID
+    assert 0 < grid <= kernel_cp_push.SC_MAX_WG
+    if num_reqs == 0:
+        return
+    assert dest_bytes < 2**31 * 4, "score offsets must fit in int32 elements"
+    run_compiled(
+        _get_kernel_cp_push(),
+        iq.data_ptr(),
+        index_cache.data_ptr(),
+        nvfp4_e4m3_lut(iq.device).data_ptr(),
+        *dests,
+        block_table.data_ptr(),
+        seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+        counts.data_ptr(),
+        *flags,
+        *iq_bufs,
+        int(iq_rows),
+        int(index_cache.stride(0)),
+        int(row_stride),
+        int(dest_bytes),
+        int(block_table.stride(0)),
+        _end_bytes(block_table),
+        int(num_reqs),
+        int(init_blocks),
+        int(local_blocks),
+        int(rank),
+        int(grid),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""NVFP4 decode index scorer for MiniMax-M3 (FlyDSL, gfx950).
+
+Per (head, query row, block): the max of q . k over the row's visible tokens,
+with AITER's init / local sentinels, on e4m3_rn_satfinite(e2m1 x scale) keys. A
+workgroup takes a chunk of up to 64 requests (lane r holds request r) and every
+splits-th block position. The distinct pages at a position (a shared prefix page
+is one page for the whole chunk) go round robin over the 4 waves; a wave
+dequantizes its page into the A fragments of v_mfma_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4, issuing
+the next page's loads into the freed registers, and scores it against every
+16-column group of Q rows holding the page.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.flydsl_utils import (
+    NT,
+    as_f32,
+    bits,
+    dequant8,
+    global_i32_ptr,
+    key_order4,
+    maxf_nn,
+    mfma_fp8_16x16x128,
+    pack8,
+    xlane4,
+)
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.nvfp4_index_prefill.kernel import with_sentinels
+
+NW = 4
+MAX_REQS = 64  # requests per chunk, one per lane
+BLK = 128  # tokens per block
+D = 128  # index head dim
+PAGE_CODES = BLK * D // 2  # page: [128 x 64 B] e2m1 codes, [128 x 8 B] e4m3 scales
+PAGE_BYTES = PAGE_CODES + BLK * 8
+MT = BLK // 16  # token tiles per page
+UMAX = 8  # max consecutive blocks per LDS-buffered unit
+MAX_ROWS = 32  # H * query_len
+
+
+def padded_rows(rows: int) -> int:
+    """Columns a request takes in the 16-column groups: rows rounded up to a
+    power of two."""
+    return 1 << (rows - 1).bit_length()
+

+def chunk_max(rows: int) -> int:
+    """Requests per chunk: one per lane, and 256 Q rows (32 KB) in LDS."""
+    return min(MAX_REQS, 256 // rows)
+
+

+    """AITER's sentinels on block b of a row seeing ``visible`` tokens."""
+    nb = ((visible < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), visible) + (BLK - 1)) // BLK
+    return with_sentinels(mx, b, nb, i32_init, i32_local)

+def compile_score_decode(rows: int, heads: int, buffered: bool = False):

+        arg_kv: fx.Int64,  # [num_blocks, 128, 72] uint8
+        arg_lut: fx.Int64,  # nvfp4_e4m3_lut [256] int64
+        arg_score: fx.Int64,  # [H, num_reqs * QL, S] fp32
+        arg_bt: fx.Int64,  # [num_reqs, >= max_blocks] int32
+        arg_seq: fx.Int64,  # [num_reqs] int32
+        i64_page_stride: fx.Int64,
+        i32_q_st: fx.Int32,  # q strides (bytes)
+        i32_q_sh: fx.Int32,
+        i64_q_bytes: fx.Int64,
+        i32_s_sh: fx.Int32,  # score strides (elements)
+        i32_s_st: fx.Int32,
+        i64_s_bytes: fx.Int64,
+        i32_bt_stride: fx.Int32,
+        i64_bt_bytes: fx.Int64,

+        wave = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, tx // 64))

+        split = pid // i32_nch

+        btr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_bt, num_records_bytes=i64_bt_bytes

+        sr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_score, num_records_bytes=i64_s_bytes
+        )

+            arg_q, num_records_bytes=i64_q_bytes

+            fx.make_view(
+                fx.recast_iter(fx.Int32, smem.q.ptr),
+                fx.make_layout(QROWS * QROW_BYTES // 4, 1),

+            fx.make_layout(4, 1),

+        scb = smem.sbuf.ptr

+                r = fx.make_rmem_tensor(fx.make_layout(4, 1), fx.Int32)
+                fx.copy(
+                    atom16, fx.slice(q16, (None, i * 8 + ((2 * kl + h) ^ (i & 7)))), r
+                )

+        code_off = (col * 64 + kl * 16) // 4  # dwords
+        scale_off = col * 4 + kl  # u16: groups 2 kl, 2 kl + 1 of token col
+
+        def page_rsrc(page):
+            return buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                arg_kv + fx.Int64(page) * i64_page_stride, num_records_bytes=PAGE_BYTES
+            )

+        def load_tile(kr, ok, t):

+            its two group scales; no memory access when not ``ok``."""
+            c = Vec(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    kr,
+                    code_off,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=fx.Int32,
+                    mask=ok,
+                    soffset_bytes=t * 1024,
+                    cache_modifier=NT,

+            )

+                fx.Int16(
+                    buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        kr,
+                        scale_off,
+                        vec_width=1,
+                        dtype=fx.Int16,
+                        mask=ok,
+                        soffset_bytes=PAGE_CODES + t * 128,
+                        cache_modifier=NT,

+                ).to(fx.Int32)

+        def dequant_tile(c, sc):

+                        b,
+                        jpos,
+                    )

+                        dtype=fx.Int32,

+                )

+
+Rank ``me`` scores blocks b with (b // CP_CH) % 4 == me for all four index heads
+(bit for bit as ``kernel.py``) and stores head h's scores into rank h's buffer
+(``index_cp.IndexCP``); it returns once every rank's scores have arrived.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.flydsl_utils import (
+    NT,
+    SC0,
+    SC1,
+    bits,
+    dequant8,
+    global_i32_ptr,
+    key_order4,
+    maxf_nn,
+    mfma_fp8_16x16x128,
+    pack8,
+    perm,
+    xlane4,
+)
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.ops.nvfp4_index_decode.kernel import block_sentinels
+
+WORLD = 4  # TP ranks = index heads, one per rank
+BLK = 128  # tokens per block
+D = 128
+CP_CH = 16  # blocks per run of one rank
+PAGE_CODES = BLK * D // 2  # e2m1 codes, then [128 x 8 B] e4m3 group scales
+PAGE_BYTES = PAGE_CODES + BLK * 8
+MT = BLK // 16  # token tiles per page
+SYS = SC0 | SC1
+MAX_ROWS = 1024  # decode rows (max_num_seqs x query_len) the receive buffers hold
+# Flag words per rank: [SC_FLAGS + p] source p's scores arrived, [SC_DONE + w]
+# workgroup w done, [SC_IQ + p * SC_MAX_REQS + r] source p's index-q of request r.
+SC_FLAGS = 64
+SC_DONE = 1024
+SC_MAX_WG = 1024
+SC_IQ = 2048
+SC_MAX_REQS = 256
+FLAG_BYTES = 12288
+# Device counters (int32); [CNT_SC] holds the call count.
+CNT_SC = 128
+CNT_WORDS = 512
+
+
+def _flag_read(addr):
+    """An atomic add of 0 at system scope (never hoisted out of a spin loop)."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        _llvm.AtomicRMWOp(
+            _llvm.AtomicBinOp.add,
+            global_i32_ptr(addr).llvm_ptr,
+            fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
+            _llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
+            syncscope="",
+            alignment=4,
+        ).result
+    )
+
+
+def _sel4(p, a0, a1, a2, a3):
+    return (p == 0).select(a0, (p == 1).select(a1, (p == 2).select(a2, a3)))
+
+
+GRID_SMALL, GRID = 512, 768
+GRID_SMALL_REQS = 32
+NW = 4  # waves per workgroup: quarter w of every run
+QD = CP_CH // NW  # blocks per quarter
+WIN = 64  # pages per block-table window (one VGPR)
+MAX_REQS = 64 * NW  # one request per thread in the prefix sum
+QL = 4  # DSpark rows per request
+HEADS = 4
+
+
+def _uni(x):
+    return fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(x)))
+
+
+def _min(a, b):
+    return (a < b).select(a, b)
+
+
+def _max(a, b):
+    return (a > b).select(a, b)
+
+
+def _wave_scan(x, lane):
+    """Inclusive prefix sum over the wave's 64 lanes."""
+    for d in range_constexpr(6):
+        y = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.ds_bpermute(T.i32, (lane - (1 << d)) * 4, x))
+        x = x + (lane >= (1 << d)).select(y, fx.Int32(0))
+    return x
+
+
+def compile_score_push():
+    name = "m3_nvfp4_index_score_push_cp"
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Shared:
+        lut: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 512, 16]
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * 16 * NW * QD, 16]  # [run % 2][col][quarter]
+        incl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, MAX_REQS]  # inclusive prefix of the run counts
+        seq: fx.Array[fx.Int32, MAX_REQS]
+        wsum: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NW]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[64 * NW, 1, 1])
+    def kernel(
+        arg_iq: fx.Int64,  # this rank's head: [num_reqs * QL, 128] e4m3
+        arg_kv: fx.Int64,  # NVFP4 index pages [num_blocks, 128, 72] u8
+        arg_lut: fx.Int64,  # nvfp4_e4m3_lut [256] i64
+        arg_d0: fx.Int64,  # head h's scores [rows, S] fp32 (rank h's receive buffer)
+        arg_d1: fx.Int64,
+        arg_d2: fx.Int64,
+        arg_d3: fx.Int64,
+        arg_bt: fx.Int64,  # block table [num_reqs, >= max_blocks] i32
+        arg_seq: fx.Int64,  # seq_lens [num_reqs] i32
+        arg_cnt: fx.Int64,  # device counters (CNT_*)
+        arg_f0: fx.Int64,  # rank p's flag words
+        arg_f1: fx.Int64,
+        arg_f2: fx.Int64,
+        arg_f3: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q0: fx.Int64,  # rank p's index-q receive buffer [4, rmax, 128] e4m3
+        arg_q1: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q2: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q3: fx.Int64,
+        i32_rmax: fx.Int32,
+        i64_page_stride: fx.Int64,
+        i32_s: fx.Int32,  # score row stride (elements)
+        i64_d_bytes: fx.Int64,
+        i32_bt_stride: fx.Int32,
+        i64_bt_bytes: fx.Int64,
+        i32_num_reqs: fx.Int32,
+        i32_init: fx.Int32,  # leading blocks forced in (sentinel 1e30)
+        i32_local: fx.Int32,  # trailing blocks forced in (sentinel 1e29)
+        i32_me: fx.Int32,
+        i32_nwg: fx.Int32,  # the grid
+    ):
+        smem = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Shared).peek()
+        tx, pid = fx.thread_idx.x, fx.block_idx.x
+        lane = tx % 64
+        wave = _uni(tx // 64)
+        col, kl = lane % 16, lane // 16
+        st_qoff = col // HEADS  # this lane's column: row st_qoff of head st_head
+        st_head = col % HEADS
+        incl_l, seq_l = smem.incl.ptr, smem.seq.ptr
+
+        cr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_cnt, num_records_bytes=CNT_WORDS * 4
+        )
+        calls = (
+            _uni(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    cr, CNT_SC, vec_width=1, dtype=fx.Int32, cache_modifier=SC1
+                )
+            )
+            + 1
+        )
+        btr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_bt, num_records_bytes=i64_bt_bytes
+        )
+        qbytes = fx.Int64(i32_rmax) * (HEADS * D)
+        qs = (arg_q0, arg_q1, arg_q2, arg_q3)
+        fs = (arg_f0, arg_f1, arg_f2, arg_f3)
+        mine = _sel4(i32_me, arg_f0, arg_f1, arg_f2, arg_f3)
+        qr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            _sel4(i32_me, arg_q0, arg_q1, arg_q2, arg_q3), num_records_bytes=qbytes
+        )
+        drs = [
+            buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                d, num_records_bytes=i64_d_bytes
+            )
+            for d in (arg_d0, arg_d1, arg_d2, arg_d3)
+        ]
+
+        # LUT to LDS; per request this rank's run count, prefix-summed.
+        lut_g = global_i32_ptr(arg_lut)
+        lut_l = smem.lut.ptr
+        for i in range_constexpr(2):
+            lut_l[tx * 2 + i] = fx.Int32(lut_g[tx * 2 + i])
+        r_ok = tx < i32_num_reqs
+        seq_t = fx.Int32(global_i32_ptr(arg_seq)[r_ok.select(tx, fx.Int32(0))])
+        seq_t = r_ok.select(seq_t, fx.Int32(0))
+        # This rank's index-q rows of requests pid, pid + nwg, ... to slot me of
+        # every rank; their flags follow below.
+        ir = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            arg_iq, num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_num_reqs) * (QL * D)
+        )
+        rs = pid
+        while (wave == 0) & (rs < i32_num_reqs):
+            v = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                ir,
+                (rs * QL * D + lane * 16) // 4,
+                vec_width=4,
+                dtype=fx.Int32,
+                mask=lane < QL * D // 16,
+            )
+            for p in range_constexpr(WORLD):
+                buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+                    v,
+                    buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                        qs[p], num_records_bytes=qbytes
+                    ),
+                    ((i32_me * i32_rmax + rs * QL) * D + lane * 16) // 4,
+                    mask=lane < QL * D // 16,
+                    cache_modifier=SYS,
+                )
+            rs = rs + i32_nwg
+        nb_t = (seq_t + (BLK - 1)) // BLK
+        runs_t = (nb_t // (WORLD * CP_CH)) + (
+            nb_t % (WORLD * CP_CH) > i32_me * CP_CH
+        ).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+        x = _wave_scan(runs_t, lane)
+        if lane == 63:
+            smem.wsum.ptr[wave] = x
+        seq_l[tx] = seq_t
+        fx.gpu.barrier()
+        for w in range_constexpr(NW - 1):
+            x = x + (wave > w).select(fx.Int32(smem.wsum.ptr[w]), fx.Int32(0))
+        incl_l[tx] = x
+        fx.gpu.barrier()
+
+        # Runs pid, pid + grid, ...: the busy workgroups stay one per CU.
+        total = _uni(incl_l[MAX_REQS - 1])
+        nruns = (pid < total).select((total - pid + i32_nwg - 1) // i32_nwg, 0)
+        nslots = nruns * QD  # pages of this wave
+
+        lut8 = fx.logical_divide(
+            fx.make_view(
+                fx.recast_iter(fx.Int32, smem.lut.ptr), fx.make_layout(512, 1)
+            ),
+            fx.make_layout(2, 1),
+        )
+        lut_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy64b(), fx.Int32)
+        stage16 = fx.logical_divide(
+            fx.make_view(
+                fx.recast_iter(fx.Int32, smem.stage.ptr),
+                fx.make_layout(2 * 16 * NW * QD, 1),
+            ),
+            fx.make_layout(4, 1),
+        )
+        atom16 = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), fx.Int32)
+
+        def lut_load(sbyte):
+            r = fx.make_rmem_tensor(fx.make_layout(2, 1), fx.Int32)
+            fx.copy(lut_atom, fx.slice(lut8, (None, sbyte)), r)
+            v = Vec(r.load())
+            return fx.Int32(v[0]), fx.Int32(v[1])
+
+        code_off = (col * 64 + kl * 16) // 4  # dwords
+        # Scales 2 kl, 2 kl + 1 of token col as a dword: a u16 load's sign
+        # extension made the loop head wait for the whole next page.
+        scale_off = col * 2 + kl // 2  # dwords
+        # v_perm selectors: scale byte 2 (kl % 2) (+ 1) of the dword, zeros above
+        scale_sel = (kl % 2) * 2 + 0x0C0C0C00
+
+        def page_rsrc(page):
+            return buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                arg_kv + fx.Int64(page) * i64_page_stride, num_records_bytes=PAGE_BYTES
+            )
+
+        def load_tile(kr, ok, t):
+            """Tile t: this lane's codes and scales; no memory access unless ok."""
+            c = Vec(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    kr,
+                    code_off,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=fx.Int32,
+                    mask=ok,
+                    soffset_bytes=t * 1024,
+                    cache_modifier=NT,
+                )
+            )
+            sc = fx.Int32(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    kr,
+                    scale_off,
+                    vec_width=1,
+                    dtype=fx.Int32,
+                    mask=ok,
+                    soffset_bytes=PAGE_CODES + t * 128,
+                    cache_modifier=NT,
+                )
+            )
+            return c, sc
+
+        def dequant_tile(c, sc):
+            """The A fragment of a tile (e4m3 keys, even dims then odd dims per 8)"""
+            t0 = lut_load(perm(sc, sc, scale_sel))
+            t1 = lut_load(perm(sc, sc, scale_sel + 1))
+            f = []
+            for e in range_constexpr(4):
+                lo, hi = dequant8(fx.Int32(Vec(c)[e]), *(t0 if e < 2 else t1))
+                f += [lo, hi]
+            return Vec.from_elements(f, fx.Int32)
+
+        def q_load(r, ok):
+            """This lane's 32 B of Q: row r * QL + st_qoff, head st_head."""
+            off = ((st_head * i32_rmax + r * QL + st_qoff) * D + kl * 32) // 4
+            a = Vec(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(qr, off, vec_width=4, dtype=fx.Int32, mask=ok)
+            )
+            b = Vec(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    qr, off + 4, vec_width=4, dtype=fx.Int32, mask=ok
+                )
+            )
+            return a, b
+
+        def q_frag(a, b):
+            """B operand: the 32 B in the key's dim order."""
+            halves = []
+            for v in (a, b):
+                d = [fx.Int32(Vec(v)[e]) for e in range_constexpr(4)]
+                halves.append(key_order4(d))
+            return pack8(halves[0], halves[1])
+
+        zero4 = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+        neg_inf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
+
+        def reduce(v, t, run, masked, lim):
+            for e in range_constexpr(4):
+                x = v[e]
+                if const_expr(masked):
+                    x = (lim >= t * 16 + e).select(x, neg_inf)
+                run = maxf_nn(run, x)
+            return run
+
+        def page_pass(tiles, qf, krn, okn, masked, lim):
+            """Max of this lane's column over the page; tile t of the next page
+            loads into tile t's registers (sched barriers stop LLVM hoisting)."""
+            accs = []
+            nxt = []
+            for t in range_constexpr(MT):
+                f = dequant_tile(*tiles[t])
+                nxt.append(load_tile(krn, okn, t))
+                accs.append(mfma_fp8_16x16x128(f, qf, zero4))
+                fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+            mx = neg_inf
+            if masked:
+                run_m = neg_inf
+                for t in range_constexpr(MT):
+                    run_m = reduce(accs[t], t, run_m, True, lim)
+                mx = xlane4(run_m, maxf_nn)
+            else:
+                run_u = neg_inf
+                for t in range_constexpr(MT):
+                    run_u = reduce(accs[t], t, run_u, False, None)
+                mx = xlane4(run_u, maxf_nn)
+            return mx, nxt
+
+        def row_value(mx, seq, q_off, b):
+            return block_sentinels(mx, seq - QL + q_off + 1, b, i32_init, i32_local)
+
+        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+        rs = pid
+        while (wave == 0) & (rs < i32_num_reqs):
+            for p in range_constexpr(WORLD):
+                buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+                    calls,
+                    buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                        fs[p], num_records_bytes=FLAG_BYTES
+                    ),
+                    SC_IQ + i32_me * SC_MAX_REQS + rs,
+                    mask=lane == 0,
+                    cache_modifier=SYS,
+                )
+            rs = rs + i32_nwg
+
+        w0 = fx.Int32(0)
+        while w0 < nslots:
+            # One page per lane: page s is block 4 w + s % 4 of run pid + (s // 4)
+            # * grid, of request rj (binary search in the prefix).
+            s = w0 + lane
+            k = pid + (s // QD) * i32_nwg
+            rj = fx.Int32(0)
+            for bs in range_constexpr(8):
+                step = MAX_REQS >> (bs + 1)
+                rj = (fx.Int32(incl_l[rj + step - 1]) <= k).select(rj + step, rj)
+            valid = s < nslots
+            rj = valid.select(rj, fx.Int32(0))
+            excl = (rj > 0).select(fx.Int32(incl_l[_max(rj - 1, 0)]), fx.Int32(0))
+            seqj = fx.Int32(seq_l[rj])
+            nblkj = (seqj + (BLK - 1)) // BLK
+            bj = ((k - excl) * WORLD + i32_me) * CP_CH + wave * QD + s % QD
+            frow = seqj - (QL - 1)
+            rbf = ((frow < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), frow) + (BLK - 1)) // BLK
+            ll = nblkj - i32_local
+            loc_last = (ll < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), ll)
+            # Init / local blocks every row sees whole only need their sentinel.
+            skip = (bj < rbf) & ((bj < i32_init) | (bj >= loc_last))
+            need = valid & (bj < nblkj) & ~skip
+            pgj = fx.Int32(
+                buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                    btr,
+                    need.select(rj * i32_bt_stride + bj, fx.Int32(0)),
+                    vec_width=1,
+                    dtype=fx.Int32,
+                )
+            )
+            pgj = need.select(pgj, fx.Int32(-1))
+            n = _min(nslots - w0, WIN)
+
+            p_0 = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, pgj, 0))
+            r_0 = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, rj, 0))
+            ok0 = p_0 >= 0
+            kr0 = page_rsrc(ok0.select(p_0, fx.Int32(0)))
+            fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+            tiles = []
+            for t in range_constexpr(MT):
+                tiles.append(load_tile(kr0, ok0, t))
+                fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+            # Wait for the index-q rows; lane i polls source i % 4 of its request.
+            word = mine + fx.Int64((SC_IQ + (lane % WORLD) * SC_MAX_REQS + rj) * 4)
+            want = lane < n
+            f = calls
+            if want:
+                f = _flag_read(word)
+            while fx.Int64(fx.rocdl.ballot(T.i64, want & (f < calls))) != 0:
+                if want & (f < calls):
+                    f = _flag_read(word)
+            qa, qb = q_load(r_0, n > 0)
+            # Nothing pending where the loop head merges with the back edge.
+            fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+            qf = q_frag(qa, qb)
+            qna, qnb = qa, qb
+            sw = n < 0  # false: Q of the next page already loaded
+            vq = [neg_inf] * QD
+            j = fx.Int32(0)
+            while j < n:
+                r = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, rj, j))
+                b = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, bj, j))
+                seq = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, seqj, j))
+                if sw:
+                    qf = q_frag(qna, qnb)
+                jn = j + 1
+                okj = jn < n
+                jc = okj.select(jn, fx.Int32(0))
+                pgn = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, pgj, jc))
+                rn = fx.Int32(fx.rocdl.readlane(T.i32, rj, jc))
+                okn = okj & (pgn >= 0)
+                krn = page_rsrc(okn.select(pgn, fx.Int32(0)))
+                sw = okj & (rn != r)
+                qna, qnb = q_load(rn, sw)
+                fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+                mx, tiles = page_pass(
+                    tiles,
+                    qf,
+                    krn,
+                    okn,
+                    b * BLK + (BLK - 1) > seq - QL,
+                    seq - QL + st_qoff - b * BLK - kl * 4,
+                )
+                ov = row_value(mx, seq, st_qoff, b)
+                e = (w0 + j) % QD
+                vq = [(e == i).select(ov, v) for i, v in enumerate(vq)]
+                if e == QD - 1:
+                    # The run's quarters meet in LDS; wave m % NW stores it.
+                    m = (w0 + j) // QD
+                    slot = m % 2
+                    val = fx.make_rmem_tensor(fx.make_layout(4, 1), fx.Int32)
+                    val.store(Vec.from_elements([bits(v) for v in vq], fx.Int32))
+                    if kl == 0:
+                        fx.copy(
+                            atom16,
+                            val,
+                            fx.slice(stage16, (None, (slot * 16 + col) * NW + wave)),
+                        )
+                    fx.gpu.barrier()
+                    if wave == m % NW:
+                        got = fx.make_rmem_tensor(fx.make_layout(4, 1), fx.Int32)
+                        fx.copy(
+                            atom16,
+                            fx.slice(stage16, (None, (slot * 16 + col) * NW + kl)),
+                            got,
+                        )
+                        off = (r * QL + st_qoff) * i32_s + (b - b % CP_CH) + kl * QD
+                        for h in range_constexpr(HEADS):
+                            buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+                                got.load(),
+                                drs[h],
+                                off,
+                                mask=st_head == h,
+                                cache_modifier=SYS,
+                            )
+                j = jn
+            w0 = w0 + WIN
+
+        # sc0 sc1 stores are system-visible once vmcnt drains; a release fence
+        # per workgroup would write back L2. The last workgroup (dispatched last,
+        # so its spin cannot starve the others) collects the done words, signals
+        # every rank and waits for all four.
+        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+        fx.gpu.barrier()
+        own = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+            mine, num_records_bytes=FLAG_BYTES
+        )
+        buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+            calls, own, SC_DONE + pid, mask=tx == 0, cache_modifier=SYS
+        )
+        if pid == i32_nwg - 1:
+            # Thread t polls done words t, t + 256, ...
+            def done_min():
+                lo = calls
+                for i in range_constexpr(SC_MAX_WG // (64 * NW)):
+                    w = tx + i * 64 * NW
+                    f = _flag_read(
+                        mine + fx.Int64((SC_DONE + _min(w, SC_MAX_WG - 1)) * 4)
+                    )
+                    lo = _min(lo, (w < i32_nwg).select(f, calls))
+                return lo
+
+            lo = done_min()
+            while fx.Int64(fx.rocdl.ballot(T.i64, lo < calls)) != 0:
+                lo = done_min()
+            fx.gpu.barrier()
+            _llvm.FenceOp(_llvm.AtomicOrdering.release, syncscope="")
+            for p in range_constexpr(WORLD):
+                fr = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(
+                    fs[p], num_records_bytes=FLAG_BYTES
+                )
+                buffer_ops.buffer_store(
+                    calls, fr, SC_FLAGS + i32_me, mask=tx == 0, cache_modifier=SYS
+                )
+            buffer_ops.buffer_store(calls, cr, CNT_SC, mask=tx == 0, cache_modifier=SYS)
+            if tx < WORLD:
+                f = _flag_read(mine + fx.Int64((SC_FLAGS + tx) * 4))
+                while f < calls:
+                    f = _flag_read(mine + fx.Int64((SC_FLAGS + tx) * 4))
+            fx.gpu.barrier()
+            _llvm.FenceOp(_llvm.AtomicOrdering.acquire, syncscope="")
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        arg_iq: fx.Int64,
+        arg_kv: fx.Int64,
+        arg_lut: fx.Int64,
+        arg_d0: fx.Int64,
+        arg_d1: fx.Int64,
+        arg_d2: fx.Int64,
+        arg_d3: fx.Int64,
+        arg_bt: fx.Int64,
+        arg_seq: fx.Int64,
+        arg_cnt: fx.Int64,
+        arg_f0: fx.Int64,
+        arg_f1: fx.Int64,
+        arg_f2: fx.Int64,
+        arg_f3: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q0: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q1: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q2: fx.Int64,
+        arg_q3: fx.Int64,
+        i32_rmax: fx.Int32,
+        i64_page_stride: fx.Int64,
+        i32_s: fx.Int32,
+        i64_d_bytes: fx.Int64,
+        i32_bt_stride: fx.Int32,
+        i64_bt_bytes: fx.Int64,
+        i32_num_reqs: fx.Int32,
+        i32_init: fx.Int32,
+        i32_local: fx.Int32,
+        i32_me: fx.Int32,
+        i32_nwg: fx.Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream,
+    ):
+        kernel(
+            arg_iq,
+            arg_kv,
+            arg_lut,
+            arg_d0,
+            arg_d1,
+            arg_d2,
+            arg_d3,
+            arg_bt,
+            arg_seq,
+            arg_cnt,
+            arg_f0,
+            arg_f1,
+            arg_f2,
+            arg_f3,
+            arg_q0,
+            arg_q1,
+            arg_q2,
+            arg_q3,
+            i32_rmax,
+            i64_page_stride,
+            i32_s,
+            i64_d_bytes,
+            i32_bt_stride,
+            i64_bt_bytes,
+            i32_num_reqs,
+            i32_init,
+            i32_local,
+            i32_me,
+            i32_nwg,
+        ).launch(grid=(fx.Int64(i32_nwg), 1, 1), block=(64 * NW, 1, 1), stream=stream)
+
+    launch.kernel_name = name
+    return launch
+
+
+assert CNT_SC < CNT_WORDS and SC_DONE + SC_MAX_WG <= FLAG_BYTES // 4
