+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""NVFP4 index-cache indexer impl for MiniMax M3 (SM100/SM103/SM107).
+
+The index-K side cache holds packed NVFP4 pages ``[num_blocks, 128, 72]`` (E2M1
+codes, then E4M3 block scales, no global scale) written by the fused
+qk-norm/rope insert, and index-Q is E4M3. Both sides use the MSA paged indexers
+of ``fmha_sm100`` with fused top-k, which write 15 score-ranked history pages
+plus the query's local page last (``init_blocks=0, local_blocks=1``) as
+logical block ids:
+
+* Decode scores the NVFP4 pages with the Q8KV4 decode indexer, which reads the
+  1..8 queries of each request in place (they take the last slots of its
+  8-query tile) and writes their top-k straight into the shared buffer.
+  Uniform decode batches are captured in full CUDA graphs, so each padded
+  batch size and query length gets its own CUDA-graph wrapper whose buffers
+  never move; the builder re-plans it outside capture every step.
+* Prefill has no NVFP4 kernel. Each layer dequantizes the history pages of the
+  prefill requests into compact FP8 workspace pages (what the decode kernel
+  scores) and runs the Q8KV8 prefill indexer on them, in request chunks whose
+  pages fit the gather budget.
+
+All index heads of the rank share the index keys and select their own pages.
+Prefill and decode score every head of the rank in one launch. Prefill plans
+are rebuilt every step and only run eagerly (mixed batches are never captured
+whole).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, ClassVar
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.common.indexer import (
+    MiniMaxM3IndexerBackend,
+    MiniMaxM3IndexerImpl,
+    MiniMaxM3IndexerMetadata,
+    MiniMaxM3IndexerMetadataBuilder,
+)
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.indexer_nvfp4_decode_cp import (
+    Nvfp4DecodeCPLayer,
+    Nvfp4DecodeCPPlan,
+    get_nvfp4_indexer_decode_cp,
+)
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.ops.gather_nvfp4_index_k import (
+    minimax_m3_gather_nvfp4_index_k_fp8,
+)
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import (
+    AttentionBackend,
+    CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    max_decode_query_len,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import split_decodes_and_prefills
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec
+from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import current_workspace_manager
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 128
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+TOPK_BLOCKS = 16
+# Queries per request the Q8KV4 decode indexer scores.
+DECODE_QUERY_LEN = 8
+# Longest block table the MSA indexers accept.
+MAX_PAGES = 8192
+# Index heads the Q8KV4 decode indexer scores in one launch.
+DECODE_NUM_HEADS = (1, 2, 4)
+
+
+def _msa_indexers():
+    """Import the MSA indexer wrappers.
+
+    Through ``fmha_sm100.sparse``, which binds the package's csrc JIT loader.
+    """
+    from vllm.third_party.fmha_sm100.sparse import (
+        BatchDecodeIndexerQ8KV4Wrapper,
+        BatchPrefillIndexerQ8KV8Wrapper,
+    )
+
+    return BatchDecodeIndexerQ8KV4Wrapper, BatchPrefillIndexerQ8KV8Wrapper
+
+
+def max_gather_pages(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
+    """FP8 pages one prefill chunk may gather; always fits one full request."""
+    tokens = max(
+        vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len,
+        4 * vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
+    )
+    return cdiv(tokens, PAGE_SIZE)
+
+
+class MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Backend(MiniMaxM3IndexerBackend):
+    """Indexer side-cache backend selecting the NVFP4 builder."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type["MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4MetadataBuilder"]:
+        return MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4MetadataBuilder
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4DecodeMetadata:
+    wrapper: Any  # planned CUDA-graph wrapper, None when decode CP is on
+    num_reqs: int  # includes zero-length full-CUDA-graph padding requests
+    query_len: int  # uniform, <= DECODE_QUERY_LEN
+    # Set instead of the wrapper when decode CP is on.
+    cp_plan: Nvfp4DecodeCPPlan | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4PrefillChunk:
+    wrapper: Any  # planned BatchPrefillIndexerQ8KV8Wrapper
+    # Token range within the prefill region (offsets from num_decode_tokens).
+    token_start: int
+    token_end: int
+    block_table: torch.Tensor  # [n, max_blocks] physical pages
+    num_pages: torch.Tensor  # [n] int32 history pages to gather
+    page_offsets: torch.Tensor  # [n] int32 first compact page of each request
+    total_pages: int
+    max_pages: int
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Metadata(MiniMaxM3IndexerMetadata):
+    """The base ``prefill``/``decode`` fields are unused on this path."""
+
+    decode_q8kv4: MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4DecodeMetadata | None = None
+    prefill_chunks: list[MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4PrefillChunk] = field(
+        default_factory=list
+    )
+
+
+class MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4MetadataBuilder(MiniMaxM3IndexerMetadataBuilder):
+    """Plans the MSA decode and prefill indexers once per step."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kv_cache_spec: AttentionSpec,
+        layer_names: list[str],
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        if self.max_decode_query_len > DECODE_QUERY_LEN:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "The MiniMax M3 NVFP4 indexer scores at most "
+                f"{DECODE_QUERY_LEN} decode queries per request, got "
+                f"{self.max_decode_query_len} (use num_speculative_tokens <= "
+                f"{DECODE_QUERY_LEN - 1})."
+            )
+        if self.num_index_heads not in DECODE_NUM_HEADS:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "The MiniMax M3 NVFP4 indexer serves "
+                f"{DECODE_NUM_HEADS} index heads per rank, got "
+                f"{self.num_index_heads}."
+            )
+        self.max_gather_pages = max_gather_pages(vllm_config)
+        # Decode wrapper per padded decode batch size and query length.
+        self.decode_wrappers: dict[tuple[int, int], Any] = {}
+        # Decode CP (opt-in); static, so all ranks and graphs agree.
+        self.decode_cp = get_nvfp4_indexer_decode_cp(
+            num_index_heads=self.num_index_heads,
+            max_decode_query_len=self.max_decode_query_len,
+        )
+        # Pages a request can span; decode scores at most this many.
+        self.max_decode_pages = min(
+            cdiv(vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len, PAGE_SIZE), MAX_PAGES
+        )
+        # One page-score scratch for every decode wrapper: they never run at
+        # once, and a buffer per batch size would hold 256 KiB per request at a
+        # 1M context for every batch size the engine sees. Decode batches,
+        # padded to a CUDA graph size, never exceed max_decode_reqs.
+        self.decode_score_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        if self.decode_cp is None:
+            max_decode_reqs = max(
+                vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs,
+                vllm_config.compilation_config.max_cudagraph_capture_size or 0,
+            )
+            decode_wrapper_cls, _ = _msa_indexers()
+            self.decode_score_buffer = torch.empty(
+                decode_wrapper_cls.score_buffer_size(
+                    max_decode_reqs,
+                    self.max_decode_pages,
+                    num_heads=self.num_index_heads,
+                ),
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+                device=device,
+            )
+
+    def _decode_wrapper(
+        self, block_table: torch.Tensor, seq_lens: torch.Tensor, query_len: int
+    ) -> Any:
+        num_reqs = seq_lens.shape[0]
+        wrapper = self.decode_wrappers.get((num_reqs, query_len))
+        if wrapper is None:
+            # The runner's block table and seq_lens are persistent buffers, so
+            # the wrapper reads them in place and plan() copies nothing. A
+            # strided (width-capped) block table gets its own buffer.
+            if not block_table.is_contiguous():
+                block_table = torch.empty(
+                    block_table.shape, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device
+                )
+            decode_wrapper_cls, _ = _msa_indexers()
+            wrapper = self.decode_wrappers[num_reqs, query_len] = decode_wrapper_cls(
+                num_heads=self.num_index_heads,
+                use_cuda_graph=True,
+                block_table_buffer=block_table,
+                seq_lens_buffer=seq_lens,
+                score_buffer=self.decode_score_buffer,
+            )
+        return wrapper
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Metadata:
+        num_reqs = common_attn_metadata.num_reqs
+        num_tokens = common_attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
+        seq_lens = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens
+        block_table = common_attn_metadata.block_table_tensor
+        qsl_cpu = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu
+
+        num_decodes, num_prefills, num_decode_tokens, num_prefill_tokens = (
+            split_decodes_and_prefills(
+                common_attn_metadata,
+                decode_threshold=self.reorder_batch_threshold,
+                require_uniform=True,
+            )
+        )
+        assert num_decodes + num_prefills == num_reqs
+        assert num_decode_tokens + num_prefill_tokens == num_tokens
+
+        decode: MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4DecodeMetadata | None = None
+        if num_decode_tokens > 0:
+            # num_decodes counts the zero-length requests that pad a full CUDA
+            # graph batch, so it is the batch size the graph was captured with.
+            query_lens_cpu = qsl_cpu[1 : num_decodes + 1] - qsl_cpu[:num_decodes]
+            query_len = int(query_lens_cpu[0])
+            assert torch.all((query_lens_cpu == query_len) | (query_lens_cpu == 0))
+            num_pages = min(block_table.shape[1], self.max_decode_pages)
+            if self.decode_cp is not None:
+                decode = MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4DecodeMetadata(
+                    wrapper=None,
+                    num_reqs=num_decodes,
+                    query_len=query_len,
+                    cp_plan=self.decode_cp.plan(
+                        block_table[:num_decodes, :num_pages],
+                        seq_lens[:num_decodes],
+                    ),
+                )
+            else:
+                decode_block_table = block_table[:num_decodes, :num_pages]
+                decode_seq_lens = seq_lens[:num_decodes]
+                wrapper = self._decode_wrapper(
+                    decode_block_table, decode_seq_lens, query_len
+                )
+                wrapper.plan(decode_block_table, decode_seq_lens, query_len=query_len)
+                decode = MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4DecodeMetadata(
+                    wrapper=wrapper,
+                    num_reqs=num_decodes,
+                    query_len=query_len,
+                )
+
+        prefill_chunks: list[MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4PrefillChunk] = []
+        if num_prefills > 0:
+            prefill_chunks = self._build_prefill_chunks(
+                common_attn_metadata, num_decodes
+            )
+
+        return MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Metadata(
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            max_seq_len=common_attn_metadata.max_seq_len,
+            slot_mapping=common_attn_metadata.slot_mapping,
+            num_actual_tokens=num_tokens,
+            num_decodes=num_decodes,
+            num_decode_tokens=num_decode_tokens,
+            num_prefills=num_prefills,
+            num_prefill_tokens=num_prefill_tokens,
+            decode_q8kv4=decode,
+            prefill_chunks=prefill_chunks,
+        )
+
+    def _build_prefill_chunks(
+        self, common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata, num_decodes: int
+    ) -> list[MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4PrefillChunk]:
+        _, prefill_wrapper_cls = _msa_indexers()
+        num_reqs = common_attn_metadata.num_reqs
+        seq_lens = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens
+        block_table = common_attn_metadata.block_table_tensor
+        qsl_cpu = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu[num_decodes : num_reqs + 1]
+        # Host-side lengths keep planning free of device syncs. An upper bound
+        # (async spec decode) only over-sizes the plan and the gather: the
+        # kernels mask by the device seq_lens and never score the extra pages.
+        seq_lens_cpu = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound
+        assert seq_lens_cpu is not None
+        seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu[num_decodes:num_reqs].to(torch.int32)
+        query_lens_cpu = (qsl_cpu[1:] - qsl_cpu[:-1]).to(torch.int32)
+        # Only pages before the last query's local page are ever scored.
+        history_pages = (seq_lens_cpu - 1) // PAGE_SIZE
+        device = seq_lens.device
+
+        chunks = []
+        start, num_prefills = 0, seq_lens_cpu.shape[0]
+        while start < num_prefills:
+            end, total_pages = start, 0
+            while end < num_prefills and (
+                end == start
+                or total_pages + int(history_pages[end]) <= self.max_gather_pages
+            ):
+                total_pages += int(history_pages[end])
+                end += 1
+            assert total_pages <= self.max_gather_pages
+            num_chunk_reqs = end - start
+            max_seq_len = int(seq_lens_cpu[start:end].max())
+            width = cdiv(max_seq_len, PAGE_SIZE)
+            # [cu_seqlens_q | num_pages | page_offsets | compact block table]
+            # in one pinned buffer, so a single H2D copy is truly asynchronous
+            # (a pageable one may synchronize with the stream).
+            staging = torch.empty(
+                3 * num_chunk_reqs + 1 + num_chunk_reqs * width,
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                pin_memory=True,
+            )
+            cu_seqlens_q, pages, offsets, table = staging.split(
+                [
+                    num_chunk_reqs + 1,
+                    num_chunk_reqs,
+                    num_chunk_reqs,
+                    num_chunk_reqs * width,
+                ]
+            )
+            torch.sub(qsl_cpu[start : end + 1], qsl_cpu[start], out=cu_seqlens_q)
+            pages.copy_(history_pages[start:end])
+            torch.cumsum(pages, 0, dtype=torch.int32, out=offsets)
+            offsets.sub_(pages)
+            cols = torch.arange(width, dtype=torch.int32)
+            table.view(num_chunk_reqs, width).copy_(
+                torch.where(cols < pages[:, None], offsets[:, None] + cols, 0)
+            )
+            staging_gpu = staging.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+            cu_seqlens_q_gpu, pages_gpu, offsets_gpu, table_gpu = staging_gpu.split(
+                [
+                    num_chunk_reqs + 1,
+                    num_chunk_reqs,
+                    num_chunk_reqs,
+                    num_chunk_reqs * width,
+                ]
+            )
+            lo, hi = num_decodes + start, num_decodes + end
+            token_start = int(qsl_cpu[start] - qsl_cpu[0])
+            token_end = int(qsl_cpu[end] - qsl_cpu[0])
+            wrapper = prefill_wrapper_cls(num_heads=self.num_index_heads)
+            wrapper.plan(
+                cu_seqlens_q_gpu,
+                seq_lens[lo:hi],
+                table_gpu.view(num_chunk_reqs, width),
+                total_q=token_end - token_start,
+                max_seqlen_q=int(query_lens_cpu[start:end].max()),
+                max_seqlen_k=max_seq_len,
+            )
+            chunks.append(
+                MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4PrefillChunk(
+                    wrapper=wrapper,
+                    token_start=token_start,
+                    token_end=token_end,
+                    block_table=block_table[lo:hi],
+                    num_pages=pages_gpu,
+                    page_offsets=offsets_gpu,
+                    total_pages=total_pages,
+                    max_pages=int(pages.max()),
+                )
+            )
+            start = end
+        return chunks
+
+
+class MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Impl(MiniMaxM3IndexerImpl):
+    """Decode: Q8KV4 on NVFP4 pages. Prefill: FP8 gather + Q8KV8."""
+
+    indexer_backend_cls: ClassVar[type[AttentionBackend]] = MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Backend
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        config = (
+            self.topk_blocks,
+            self.init_blocks,
+            self.local_blocks,
+            self.block_size,
+            self.index_head_dim,
+            self.score_type,
+        )
+        if config != (TOPK_BLOCKS, 0, 1, PAGE_SIZE, HEAD_DIM, "max"):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "The MiniMax M3 NVFP4 indexer supports topk_blocks=16, "
+                "init_blocks=0, local_blocks=1, 128-token blocks, index head "
+                "dim 128 and max scoring; got (topk_blocks, init_blocks, "
+                "local_blocks, block_size, index_head_dim, score_type)="
+                f"{config}."
+            )
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        self.max_gather_pages = max_gather_pages(vllm_config)
+        # Per-layer decode-CP buffers (collective: same layer order on all ranks).
+        self.decode_cp = get_nvfp4_indexer_decode_cp(
+            num_index_heads=self.num_index_heads,
+            max_decode_query_len=max_decode_query_len(vllm_config),
+        )
+        self.decode_cp_layer: Nvfp4DecodeCPLayer | None = (
+            None if self.decode_cp is None else self.decode_cp.new_layer()
+        )
+
+    def reserve_workspace(self) -> None:
+        current_workspace_manager().get_simultaneous(
+            ((self.max_gather_pages, PAGE_SIZE, HEAD_DIM), torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        index_query: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict):
+            return None, None  # profiling run; caches unbound
+        md = attn_metadata[self.index_cache.prefix]
+        assert isinstance(md, MiniMaxM3IndexerNvfp4Metadata)
+
+        nd = md.num_decode_tokens
+        # Not sliced to the actual tokens: a padded full-CUDA-graph decode
+        # batch also scores its padding rows, and every captured tensor must
+        # keep its address and shape.
+        index_q = index_query.view(-1, self.num_index_heads, self.index_head_dim)
+        kv = self.index_cache.kv_cache
+        # The kernels write logical block ids straight into the shared
+        # [T, H, 16] buffer the attend reads.
+        buf = self.topk_indices_buffer
+        assert buf is not None
+
+        if md.decode_q8kv4 is not None:
+            d = md.decode_q8kv4
+            rows = d.num_reqs * d.query_len
+            if d.cp_plan is not None:
+                assert self.decode_cp is not None and self.decode_cp_layer is not None
+                self.decode_cp.forward(
+                    self.decode_cp_layer,
+                    d.cp_plan,
+                    index_q[:rows],
+                    kv,
+                    buf[:rows],
+                    d.query_len,
+                )
+            else:
+                d.wrapper.run(index_q[:rows], kv, out=buf[:rows])
+        for chunk in md.prefill_chunks:
+            self._prefill(
+                index_q[nd + chunk.token_start : nd + chunk.token_end],
+                kv,
+                chunk,
+                buf[nd + chunk.token_start : nd + chunk.token_end],
+            )
+        return None, None

+"""Context-parallel decode for the MiniMax M3 NVFP4 indexer (opt-in, TP4).
+
+At TP4 each rank owns one of the 4 index heads, but the index-K cache is
+replicated, so every rank reads the whole cache per sparse layer. With
+``--attention-config '{"indexer_decode_cp": true}'``, rank ``r``
+instead:
+
+1. exchanges index-q heads so it holds all 4 (``_q_exchange_kernel``);
+2. scores all 4 heads over pages ``j * CP + r`` with the stock Q8KV4 kernel
+   on a compact block table, reading 1/CP of the index-K;
+3. takes the exact local top 16 per (query, head) and sends it to the head's
+   owner (``_local_topk_push_kernel``);
+4. merges the owner's ``16 * CP`` candidates into the indexer output: 15
+   pages by (score desc, page asc), then the own page (``_merge_kernel``).
+
+The merge is exact: the global top 16 lies in the union of per-rank top 16s.
+The stock decode ranks 16-bit quantized scores, so the two may differ at ties.
+
+The chunking is written against one contract, the MSA Q8KV4 decode scorer's:
+eight query slots per request, ``(seq_len - 1) / 128`` pages scored, and only
+the pages below a query's own page stored. The three places that depend on it
+are ``_compact_block_table_kernel`` (the length it is handed),
+``_local_topk_push_kernel`` (the cut that length drops) and ``_set_width``
+(room for the page that length invents).
+
+Both exchanges are NVLink stores into symmetric buffers whose payload is the
+flag (``0xFF`` E4M3 NaN for queries, ``-1`` for keys); consumers restore it.
+Buffers are per layer, shapes are fixed per batch size, and nothing syncs with
+the host, so the path is CUDA-graph safe. It needs symmetric memory across the
+tensor-parallel ranks and falls back to the stock decode without it.
+
+The three Triton kernels are PDL-launched and wait for their producer, so
+each starts its prologue in the tail of the kernel before it. Only the push
+releases its dependent early, right after its own wait, which is what lets
+the merge overlap it; the exchange must not, because the score kernel after
+it reads the whole tile.
+"""

+@triton.jit
+def _peer_ptr(ptrs, rank, dtype: tl.constexpr):
+    return tl.load(ptrs + rank).to(tl.pointer_type(dtype))
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _compact_block_table_kernel(
+    bt_ptr,  # [B, P] int32
+    seq_lens_ptr,  # [B] int32
+    cbt_ptr,  # [B, W] int32 out: compact page j -> global page j * CP + RANK
+    cseq_ptr,  # [B] int32 out: lengths the score kernel sees
+    seq_out_ptr,  # [B] int32 out: real lengths (stable buffer)
+    P,
+    W,
+    stride_bt,
+    stride_cbt,
+    CP: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Compact page j = global page ``j * CP + RANK``, and the length the score
+    kernel is handed for it.
+
+    That length is a lie: the scorer stores only the pages below a query's own
+    page, so ``n_local * 128 + 8`` puts all eight query slots one page past
+    the chunk and stores every owned page, uncausally. The real cut comes back
+    in ``_local_topk_push_kernel``. ``W`` keeps the invented page addressable,
+    since a scorer that clamps the own page to its last score column would
+    drop the chunk's last page."""
+    b = tl.program_id(0)
+    seq = tl.load(seq_lens_ptr + b)
+    tl.store(seq_out_ptr + b, seq)
+    hist = tl.minimum(tl.maximum((seq - 1) // _PAGE, 0), P)
+    n_local = tl.minimum((hist + (CP - 1 - RANK)) // CP, W - 1)
+    for start in range(0, W, BLOCK):
+        j = start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+        src = tl.minimum(j * CP + RANK, P - 1)
+        v = tl.load(bt_ptr + b.to(tl.int64) * stride_bt + src, mask=j < W)
+        tl.store(cbt_ptr + b.to(tl.int64) * stride_cbt + j, v, mask=j < W)
+    tl.store(cseq_ptr + b, n_local * _PAGE + _SLOTS)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _has_ff_byte(v):
+    u = v.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+    ff = (
+        ((u & 0xFF) == 0xFF)
+        | (((u >> 8) & 0xFF) == 0xFF)
+        | (((u >> 16) & 0xFF) == 0xFF)
+        | ((u >> 24) == 0xFF)
+    )
+    return tl.max(ff.to(tl.int32), axis=0) > 0
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _q_exchange_kernel(
+    q_ptr,  # [rows, 32] int32 view of this rank's e4m3 index-q head
+    tile_ptrs,  # [CP] int64: q tile [B, 8, H, 128] bytes of every rank
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    CP: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD: tl.constexpr,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Store this rank's index-q head into every rank's tile, then wait for
+    the other heads. The PDL wait is for index-q's producer."""
+    tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    b = t // QLEN
+    slot = (_SLOTS - QLEN) + t % QLEN
+    w = tl.arange(0, _WORDS)
+    row = tl.load(q_ptr + t * _WORDS + w)
+    dst_off = ((b * _SLOTS + slot) * H + HEAD) * _WORDS + w
+    for dst in tl.static_range(CP):
+        tl.store(_peer_ptr(tile_ptrs, dst, tl.int32) + dst_off, row)
+    local = _peer_ptr(tile_ptrs, RANK, tl.int32)
+    hw = tl.arange(0, H * _WORDS)
+    off = (b * _SLOTS + slot) * H * _WORDS + hw
+    v = tl.load(local + off, volatile=True)
+    pending = _has_ff_byte(v)
+    while pending:
+        v = tl.load(local + off, volatile=True)
+        pending = _has_ff_byte(v)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _page_keys(row_ptr, j, n, CP: tl.constexpr, RANK: tl.constexpr):
+    """Key ``1 << 48 | ordered(score) << 16 | (0xFFFF - page)`` for ``j < n``,
+    else 0. Unique; orders by score desc, then page asc."""
+    valid = j < n
+    page = j * CP + RANK
+    score = tl.load(row_ptr + j, mask=valid, other=0.0)
+    bits = score.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+    ordered = bits ^ tl.where((bits >> 31) != 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x80000000)
+    key = (1 << 48) | (ordered.to(tl.int64) << 16) | (0xFFFF - page).to(tl.int64)
+    return tl.where(valid, key, 0)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _local_topk_push_kernel(
+    score_ptr,  # [B, 8 * H, W] fp32 compact scores (row = slot * H + head)
+    seq_lens_ptr,  # [B] int32
+    recv_ptrs,  # [CP] int64: candidates [CP, rows_max, 16] int64 of every rank
+    rows_max,
+    stride_sb,
+    stride_sr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    CP: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    CHUNK: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_GROUPS: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Per (query, head): exact top 16 of the owned pages, sent to the head's
+    owner. Long rows use a two-level select (top 16 groups, then top 16).
+
+    PDL-launched: the wait is for the scores, and releasing the merge only
+    after it keeps the merge's own wait a guarantee that the score kernel has
+    read the q tile."""
+    tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+    tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    b = t // QLEN
+    i = t % QLEN
+    slot = (_SLOTS - QLEN) + i
+    own = (tl.load(seq_lens_ptr + b) - QLEN + i) // _PAGE
+    if own + 1 > _TOPK:
+        # The causal cut the compact length dropped: the rank's pages below
+        # the query's own page, bounded by the width like the scored pages (a
+        # length past the page table ranks what it holds, as the stock TopK).
+        n_rank = tl.minimum((own + (CP - 1 - RANK)) // CP, WIDTH - 1)
+        row_ptr = score_ptr + b.to(tl.int64) * stride_sb + (slot * H + h) * stride_sr
+        if n_rank <= CHUNK:
+            j = tl.arange(0, CHUNK)
+            best = tl.topk(_page_keys(row_ptr, j, n_rank, CP, RANK), _TOPK)
+        else:
+            g = tl.arange(0, NUM_GROUPS)
+            s = tl.arange(0, GROUP)
+            keys = _page_keys(
+                row_ptr, g[:, None] * GROUP + s[None, :], n_rank, CP, RANK
+            )
+            top_g = tl.topk(tl.max(keys, axis=1), _TOPK)
+            page = (0xFFFF - (top_g & 0xFFFF)).to(tl.int32)
+            grp = tl.where(top_g > 0, ((page - RANK) // CP) // GROUP, NUM_GROUPS)
+            cand = _page_keys(
+                row_ptr, grp[:, None] * GROUP + s[None, :], n_rank, CP, RANK
+            )
+            best = tl.topk(tl.reshape(cand, [_TOPK * GROUP]), _TOPK)
+        k = tl.arange(0, _TOPK)
+        dst = _peer_ptr(recv_ptrs, h, tl.int64)
+        tl.store(dst + (RANK * rows_max + t) * _TOPK + k, best)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _merge_kernel(
+    seq_lens_ptr,  # [B] int32
+    recv_ptrs,  # [CP] int64
+    tile_ptrs,  # [CP] int64
+    out_ptr,  # [rows, 1, 16] int32
+    rows_max,
+    out_stride,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    CP: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Merge all ranks' candidates for this rank's head and restore sentinels.
+
+    PDL-launched after every push program has started, so polling here never
+    blocks a push."""
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    b = t // QLEN
+    i = t % QLEN
+    own = (tl.load(seq_lens_ptr + b) - QLEN + i) // _PAGE
+    k = tl.arange(0, _TOPK)
+    out = out_ptr + t.to(tl.int64) * out_stride + k
+    if own + 1 <= _TOPK:
+        tl.store(out, tl.where(k < own + 1, k, -1))
+        # No push for this row: wait for the score before resetting the q tile.
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+    else:
+        recv = _peer_ptr(recv_ptrs, RANK, tl.int64)
+        p = tl.arange(0, CP)
+        off = (p[:, None] * rows_max + t) * _TOPK + k[None, :]
+        keys = tl.load(recv + off, volatile=True)
+        pending = tl.min(tl.min(keys, axis=1), axis=0) == -1
+        while pending:
+            keys = tl.load(recv + off, volatile=True)
+            pending = tl.min(tl.min(keys, axis=1), axis=0) == -1

+        page = (0xFFFF - (best & 0xFFFF)).to(tl.int32)

+        tile + (b * _SLOTS + slot) * H * _WORDS + hw,

+        self._tile_words = max_reqs * DECODE_QUERY_LEN * NUM_INDEX_HEADS * HEAD_DIM // 4
+        self._recv_words = self.cp * self.rows_max * TOPK_BLOCKS
+
+    def new_layer(self) -> Nvfp4DecodeCPLayer:
+        """Collective: every TP rank builds its sparse layers in the same order."""
+        import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+        group_name = get_tp_group().device_group.group_name
+        tile = symm_mem.empty(self._tile_words, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device)
+        tile.fill_(-1)
+        recv = symm_mem.empty(self._recv_words, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        recv.fill_(-1)
+        tile_ptrs = symm_mem.rendezvous(tile, group_name).buffer_ptrs
+        recv_ptrs = symm_mem.rendezvous(recv, group_name).buffer_ptrs
+        return Nvfp4DecodeCPLayer(
+            tile=tile,
+            recv=recv,
+            tile_ptrs=torch.tensor(tile_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device),
+            recv_ptrs=torch.tensor(recv_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device),
+        )
+
+    def _set_width(self, max_pages: int) -> None:
+        """Fix the compact page width and the two-level top-k shape.
+
+        One column past the pages a rank can own, so the page the compact
+        length invents stays inside the score buffer and the chunk's last page
+        is stored (see ``_compact_block_table_kernel``). Both levels of the
+        top-k select over power-of-two tiles that cover the width.
+        """
+        width = cdiv(min(max_pages, MAX_PAGES), self.cp) + 1
+        if self.width == 0:
+            padded = 1 << (width - 1).bit_length()
+            self.width = width

+            self.num_groups = padded // self.group

+    def plan(

+    ) -> Nvfp4DecodeCPPlan:

+        num_reqs = seq_lens.shape[0]
+        p = self._plans.get(num_reqs)
+        if p is None:
+            assert num_reqs <= self.max_reqs
+            i32 = dict(dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device)
+            bt = torch.empty(num_reqs, self.width, **i32)
+            score_seq_lens = torch.empty(num_reqs, **i32)
+            p = self._plans[num_reqs] = Nvfp4DecodeCPPlan(
+                wrapper=self._wrapper_cls(
+                    num_heads=NUM_INDEX_HEADS,
+                    use_cuda_graph=True,
+                    block_table_buffer=bt,
+                    seq_lens_buffer=score_seq_lens,
+                ),
+                block_table=bt,

+                seq_lens=torch.empty(num_reqs, **i32),
+                num_reqs=num_reqs,

+            self.rows_max,
+            out.stride(0),
+            H=NUM_INDEX_HEADS,
+            CP=self.cp,
+            RANK=self.rank,
+            QLEN=query_len,
+            num_warps=1,
+            launch_pdl=True,

+_RESOLVED = False

+"""MXFP8 dense GEMM1 (gate_up) with fused clamped-SwiGLU + MXFP8 quant epilogue.
+
+One persistent SM100 tcgen05 MXFP8 GEMM tuned for prefill shapes (BM=128,
+BN=128 per gate/up half, BK=128, cta_group=2; 6-warp CTA: warps 0-3
+epilogue, warp 4 MMA, warp 5 TMA) computes ``gate = X @ Wg^T`` and
+``up = X @ Wu^T`` and applies clamped SwiGLU and MXFP8 quantization. No
+BF16 intermediate.
+
+The tmem accumulator is double-buffered with a 32-col overlap (even tiles
+[0,256), odd [224,480), SF fixed [500,512)): the epilogue reads the shared
+32-col group first, so the next tile's MMA waits on a 32-col read instead
+of 256. The single epilogue warpgroup processes a tile in 32-col chunks
+(load -> act+quant -> store), overlap chunk first.
+
+Tile order: flat (n-fastest) when the B operand fits in half of L2, else
+grouped m-fastest (GROUP_M=32) so B panels stay L2-resident (dense TP1:
+B=151MB > 126MB L2).
+"""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cutlass
+import torch
+from cuda.bindings.driver import CUstream
+from cutlass import (
+    Float8E4M3FN,
+    Float8E8M0FNU,
+    Float32,
+    Int32,
+    Int64,
+    Uint8,
+    Uint16,
+    Uint32,
+    Uint64,
+    cute,
+)
+from cutlass.cute.nvgpu import cpasync, tcgen05
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor
+
+from vllm.cute_utils import _tcgen05, mbarrier, simple_tma_copy, to_cta0_smem
+from vllm.cute_utils.cvt import fp32x4_to_fp8x4
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import kMxfp8Dynamic
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+class Sm100DenseGemm1Mxfp8:
+    def __init__(self, GROUP_M: int, use_pdl: bool = True) -> None:
+        BM, BN, BK = 128, 128, 128
+        self.cta_tile = (BM, BN, BK)
+        self.GROUP_M = GROUP_M
+        self.use_pdl = use_pdl
+
+        smem_bytes = cutlass.memory.SmemAllocator.capacity_in_bytes()
+        # A + Bg/2 + Bu/2 tiles + SFA + SFBg + SFBu (2-CTA: B halves, SF full)
+        self.stage_size = (BM + BN) * BK + (BM + 256) * (BK // 32)
+        self.num_stages = smem_bytes // self.stage_size
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def prepare_AB(self, A: cute.Tensor, BM: int, BK: int) -> cpasync.TmaInfo:
+        tma_op = cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(cta_group=tcgen05.CtaGroup.TWO)
+        swizzle_128B = cute.make_swizzle(3, 4, 3)
+        s_layout = cute.make_layout((BM, BK, self.num_stages), stride=(BK, 1, BM * BK))
+        s_layout = cute.make_composed_layout(swizzle_128B, 0, s_layout)
+        return cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(tma_op, A, s_layout, (BM, BK))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def prepare_SF(
+        self,
+        SF: cute.Tensor,
+        R: Int32,
+        Ksf: Int32,
+        BR: int,
+        BKsf: int,
+        tma_op: cpasync.CopyG2STileBaseOp,
+    ) -> cpasync.TmaInfo:
+        g_layout = cute.make_layout((Ksf * 128, cute.ceil_div(R, 128)))
+        SF_i64 = cute.recast_tensor(cute.make_tensor(SF.iterator, g_layout), Int64)
+        tiler = (128 * BKsf // 8, BR // 128)
+        s_layout = cute.make_layout((*tiler, self.num_stages))
+        return cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(tma_op, SF_i64, s_layout, tiler)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        A: cute.Tensor,
+        B: cute.Tensor,
+        SFA: cute.Tensor,
+        SFB: cute.Tensor,
+        Q: cute.Tensor,
+        SFQ: cute.Tensor,
+        limit: Float32,
+        alpha: Float32,
+        beta: Float32,
+        grid_size: Int32,
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ) -> None:
+        M, K = A.shape
+        N2, _ = B.shape  # 2 * N (gate|up)
+        BM, BN, BK = self.cta_tile
+
+        A_tma = self.prepare_AB(A, BM, BK)
+        B_tma = self.prepare_AB(B, BN, BK)
+        SFA_tma = self.prepare_SF(
+            SFA,
+            M,
+            K // 32,
+            BM,
+            BK // 32,
+            cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(tcgen05.CtaGroup.TWO),
+        )
+        SFB_tma = self.prepare_SF(
+            SFB,
+            N2,
+            K // 32,
+            BN,
+            BK // 32,
+            cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SMulticastOp(tcgen05.CtaGroup.TWO),
+        )
+
+        self.kernel(A_tma, B_tma, SFA_tma, SFB_tma, Q, SFQ, limit, alpha, beta).launch(
+            grid=(grid_size, 1, 1),
+            block=(6 * 32, 1, 1),
+            cluster=(2, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=self.use_pdl,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        A_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        B_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        SFA_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        SFB_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        Q_tensor: cute.Tensor,
+        SFQ_tensor: cute.Tensor,
+        limit: Float32,
+        alpha: Float32,
+        beta: Float32,
+    ) -> None:
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        raw_bid, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        num_bids, _, _ = cute.arch.grid_dim()
+        warp_id = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(tid // 32)
+        cta_rank = raw_bid % 2
+
+        BM, BN, BK = self.cta_tile
+        GROUP_M = self.GROUP_M
+        num_stages = self.num_stages
+
+        smem = cutlass.memory.SmemAllocator()
+        sA = smem.allocate_tensor(
+            Float8E4M3FN,
+            A_tma.smem_layout.outer,
+            byte_alignment=128,
+            swizzle=A_tma.smem_layout.inner,
+        )
+        sB = smem.allocate_tensor(
+            Float8E4M3FN,
+            B_tma.smem_layout.outer,
+            byte_alignment=128,
+            swizzle=B_tma.smem_layout.inner,
+        )
+        sSFA = smem.allocate_tensor(Int64, SFA_tma.smem_layout, byte_alignment=128)
+        # SFB slots: rank r's multicast copy fills slot r of BOTH CTAs;
+        # slice shape/stride per slot matches the atom's (64,1):(1,64) tile
+        sSFB = smem.allocate_tensor(
+            Int64,
+            cute.make_layout((64, 1, 2, num_stages), stride=(1, 64, 64, 128)),
+            byte_alignment=128,
+        )
+
+        tma_full_mbar = smem.allocate_array(Int64, num_stages)
+        tma_empty_mbar = smem.allocate_array(Int64, num_stages)
+        tmem_full_mbar = smem.allocate_array(Int64, 2)
+        tmem_partial_mbar = smem.allocate_array(Int64, 1)
+        tmem_empty_mbar = smem.allocate_array(Int64, 2)
+        taddr = smem.allocate(Int32, 4)
+
+        # allocate named barrier
+        BAR_EPI = 1
+        BAR_TMEM_ALLOC = 2
+

+        N2, _ = B_tma.tma_tensor.shape
+        N = N2 // 2
+        grid_m = cute.ceil_div(M, BM * 2) * 2
+        grid_n = N // BN
+        total_tiles = grid_m * grid_n
+        # output SF swizzle: NUM_K_TILES = ceil(N/32/4) tiles of 512B per 128 rows
+        NUM_KT = cute.ceil_div(N // 32, 4)
+
+        def compute_bid(bid, GROUP_M, grid_m, grid_n):
+            if cutlass.const_expr(GROUP_M == 0):
+                bid_m = (bid // (grid_n * 2)) * 2 + bid % 2
+                bid_n = (bid // 2) % grid_n
+            else:
+                group_size = GROUP_M * grid_n
+                group_id = bid // group_size
+                group_m = min(grid_m - group_id * GROUP_M, GROUP_M)
+                local_bid = bid - group_id * group_size
+                bid_m = group_id * GROUP_M + local_bid % group_m
+                bid_n = local_bid // group_m
+            return bid_m, bid_n
+
+        if warp_id == 0:
+            with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_stages):
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_init(tma_full_mbar + i, 2)
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_init(tma_empty_mbar + i, 1)
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_init(tmem_full_mbar + i, 1)
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_init(tmem_empty_mbar + i, 256)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(tmem_partial_mbar, 256)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init_fence()
+        elif warp_id == 1:
+            cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(A_tma.atom)
+            cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(B_tma.atom)
+            cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(SFA_tma.atom)
+            cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(SFB_tma.atom)

+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()

+            gSFA_tiles = cute.zipped_divide(

+            gSFB_tiles = cute.zipped_divide(

+                        A_tma.atom,
+                        gA_tiles[None, (bid_m, iter_k)],
+                        sA[None, None, tma_stage],
+                        mbar,
+                    )
+                    simple_tma_copy(
+                        B_tma.atom,
+                        gB_tiles[None, (cta_rank * grid_n + bid_n, iter_k)],
+                        sB[None, None, tma_stage],
+                        mbar,
+                    )
+                    simple_tma_copy(
+                        SFA_tma.atom,
+                        gSFA_tiles[None, (iter_k, bid_m)],
+                        sSFA[None, None, tma_stage],

+

+            tma_full_parity = 0

+                tmem_parity = 1

+"""Gather NVFP4 index-K pages into compact FP8 pages for the Q8KV8 prefill indexer.
+
+A packed NVFP4 page ``[128, 72]`` holds the E2M1 codes of all 128 tokens (64 B
+per token, low nibble first) followed by their E4M3 16-element block scales
+(``token * 8 + group``), with no global scale. Each element dequantizes to
+``e4m3_rn_satfinite(e2m1 * scale)``, the value the Q8KV4 decode indexer scores,
+so prefill and decode rank pages from identical keys.
+
+Where Triton can emit it, each four elements are one QMUL4
+(``mul.rn.satfinite.e4m3x4.e2m1x4.e4m3x4``), the instruction the decode kernel
+dequantizes with; otherwise the product is formed exactly in fp32 and rounded
+once, which gives the same bytes.
+"""
+
+import functools
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 128
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+E4M3_MAX = 448.0
+# QMUL4 needs PTX ISA 9.4 (ptxas 13.4) and an sm_100a/sm_103a target.
+QMUL4_MIN_PTX_VERSION = 94
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _qmul4_supported(device_index: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether Triton emits PTX that can use QMUL4 on this device.
+
+    Triton takes the PTX ISA version from its Blackwell ptxas: the bundled one
+    unless ``TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH`` points at a CUDA 13.4+ ptxas.
+    """
+    capability = current_platform.get_device_capability(device_index)
+    if capability is None or capability.to_int() not in (100, 103):
+        return False
+    try:
+        from triton.backends.nvidia.compiler import get_ptxas, ptx_get_version
+
+        ptxas_version = get_ptxas(capability.to_int()).version
+        return ptx_get_version(ptxas_version) >= QMUL4_MIN_PTX_VERSION
+    except Exception:
+        # Triton-internal helpers; without them keep the portable path.
+        return False
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _e2m1_to_f32(code):
+    # |code| 0..7 -> 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6; bit 3 is the sign.
+    exponent = (code >> 1) & 3
+    mantissa = (code & 1).to(tl.float32)
+    normal = (2.0 + mantissa) * (1 << exponent).to(tl.float32) * 0.25
+    value = tl.where(exponent == 0, 0.5 * mantissa, normal)
+    # Multiply (not negate) so that code 8 stays -0, as in the decode kernel.
+    return value * tl.where((code & 8) != 0, -1.0, 1.0)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _gather_nvfp4_index_k_fp8_kernel(
+    kv_cache,
+    block_table,
+    num_pages,
+    page_offsets,
+    out,
+    kv_page_stride,
+    block_table_stride,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    E4M3_MAX: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_QMUL4: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.program_id(1)
+    if col >= tl.load(num_pages + req):
+        return
+    page = tl.load(block_table + req * block_table_stride + col).to(tl.int64)
+    dst_page = (tl.load(page_offsets + req) + col).to(tl.int64)
+
+    src = kv_cache + page * kv_page_stride
+    dst = out + dst_page * (PAGE_SIZE * HEAD_DIM)
+    tokens = tl.arange(0, PAGE_SIZE)[:, None]
+    scales = src + PAGE_SIZE * (HEAD_DIM // 2) + tokens * (HEAD_DIM // 16)
+    if USE_QMUL4:
+        # A 16-bit word holds four elements of one group; multiply it by the
+        # group's scale byte broadcast to E4M3x4.
+        words = tl.arange(0, HEAD_DIM // 4)[None, :]
+        packed4 = tl.load(
+            src.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.uint16)) + tokens * (HEAD_DIM // 4) + words
+        )
+        scale4 = tl.load(scales + words // 4).to(tl.uint32) * 0x01010101
+        values4 = tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+            "{ .reg .b16 v; cvt.u16.u32 v, $1; "
+            "mul.rn.satfinite.e4m3x4.e2m1x4.e4m3x4 $0, v, $2; }",
+            "=r,r,r",
+            [packed4.to(tl.uint32), scale4],
+            dtype=tl.uint32,
+            is_pure=True,
+            pack=1,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            dst.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.uint32)) + tokens * (HEAD_DIM // 4) + words,
+            values4,
+        )
+        return
+
+    packed_cols = tl.arange(0, HEAD_DIM // 2)[None, :]
+    packed = tl.load(src + tokens * (HEAD_DIM // 2) + packed_cols)
+    # Packed byte b holds elements 2b and 2b+1, both in group b // 8.
+    scale = tl.load(scales + packed_cols // 8)
+    scale = scale.to(tl.float8e4nv, bitcast=True).to(tl.float32)
+    # e2m1 * e4m3 is exact in fp32; clamp, then round once to e4m3.
+    low = _e2m1_to_f32(packed & 0xF) * scale
+    high = _e2m1_to_f32(packed >> 4) * scale
+    values = tl.interleave(low, high)
+    values = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(values, -E4M3_MAX), E4M3_MAX)
+    tl.store(
+        dst + tokens * HEAD_DIM + tl.arange(0, HEAD_DIM)[None, :],
+        values.to(tl.float8e4nv),
+    )

+    y = acc[None, 1].load()

+    # op's 1e-12 amax floor lies below that and is omitted. Both groups'
+    # scales share one e4m3x2 cvt.
+    amax_6 = cute.make_rmem_tensor(2, Float32)
+    for g in range(2):
+        gmax = Float32(0.0)
+        for i in range(16 * g, 16 * g + 16):
+            gmax = cute.arch.fmax(gmax, cute.math.abs(vals[i]))
+        a = gmax * Float32(1.0 / 6.0)
+        if sf_scale is not None:
+            a = a * sf_scale
+        amax_6[g] = cute.arch.fmax(a, Float32(2.0**-9))

+    q = cute.make_rmem_tensor(32, Float32)
+    for g in range(2):

+        r = cute.arch.rcp_approx(sf_f32[g])

+        for i in range(16 * g, 16 * g + 16, 2):

+    for j in range(4):

+def _nvfp4_quant64(vals, sf_scale=None):

+            tma_empty_parity = 1
+            tma_full_mbar_ = to_cta0_smem(tma_full_mbar)
+
+            gA_tiles = cute.zipped_divide(A_tma.tma_tensor, (BM, BK))

+
+            for bid in range(raw_bid, total_tiles, num_bids):

+
+                for iter_k in cutlass.range(cute.ceil_div(K, BK), unroll=1):

+            tmem_parity = 0

+                        if cutlass.const_expr(has_qfp8):

+
+                elif head < self.v_start:

+                    _rms_norm(acc, sW[None, None, W_K], eps)

+                    kv_slot = 2 * (head - self.v_start) + 1
+                    slot = SLOT_tensor[m_safe]
+                    page, token = slot // bs, slot % bs

+                    for h in (0, 1):

+                tmem_stage ^= 1

+class _QkvIndexFusedEpilogueJit(
+    VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel["_QkvIndexFusedEpilogueJit.CompileKey"]
+):
+    """Compile keys, warmup (fake) inputs and the compiled executors of
+    QkvIndexFusedEpilogueKernel."""
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class CompileKey:
+        has_q: bool
+        has_qfp8: bool
+        nkv: int
+        block_size: int
+        group_m: int
+        cta_group: int
+        use_pdl: bool = True
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def kernel(key: CompileKey) -> QkvIndexFusedEpilogueKernel:
+        return QkvIndexFusedEpilogueKernel(
+            key.nkv, key.block_size, key.cta_group, key.group_m, key.use_pdl
+        )
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(self, **fields) -> list[CompileKey]:
+        # a layer's keys differ only in the tile config, picked per batch size
+        return [self.CompileKey(cta_group=cg, **fields) for cg in (1, 2)]
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, key: CompileKey) -> tuple:
+        M = cute.sym_int()
+        N = cute.sym_int()
+        K = cute.sym_int()
+        P = cute.sym_int()
+        slot_bytes = key.block_size * (HEAD_DIM // 2 + HEAD_DIM // 16)
+
+        A = make_fake_tensor(
+            Float8E4M3FN, (M, K), (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=16), 1), assumed_align=16
+        )
+        B = make_fake_tensor(
+            Float8E4M3FN, (N, K), (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=16), 1), assumed_align=16
+        )
+        SFA = make_fake_tensor(
+            Float8E8M0FNU, (cute.sym_int(divisibility=512),), (1,), assumed_align=16
+        )
+        SFB = make_fake_tensor(
+            Float8E8M0FNU, (cute.sym_int(divisibility=512),), (1,), assumed_align=16
+        )
+        q_cols = 16 * key.nkv * HEAD_DIM
+        Q = (
+            make_fake_tensor(BFloat16, (M, q_cols), (q_cols, 1), assumed_align=32)
+            if key.has_q
+            else None
+        )
+        WQ, WK, WIQ, WIK = (
+            make_fake_tensor(BFloat16, (HEAD_DIM,), (1,), assumed_align=16)
+            for _ in range(4)
+        )
+        COS_SIN = make_fake_tensor(BFloat16, (P, 64), (64, 1), assumed_align=16)
+        POS = make_fake_tensor(Int64, (M,), (1,), assumed_align=16)
+        # caches as [nb, page_bytes] with a dynamic page stride: no dynamic dim
+        # may exceed int32, and cross-layer layouts space pages wider than a page
+        KVC = make_fake_tensor(
+            Uint8,
+            (cute.sym_int(), 2 * key.nkv * slot_bytes),
+            (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=32), 1),
+            assumed_align=32,
+        )
+        IDXC = make_fake_tensor(
+            Uint8,
+            (cute.sym_int(), slot_bytes),
+            (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=32), 1),
+            assumed_align=32,
+        )
+        SLOT = make_fake_tensor(Int64, (M,), (1,), assumed_align=16)
+        IDX_SLOT = make_fake_tensor(Int64, (M,), (1,), assumed_align=16)
+        IQFP8 = make_fake_tensor(
+            Float8E4M3FN,
+            (M, key.nkv * HEAD_DIM),
+            (key.nkv * HEAD_DIM, 1),
+            assumed_align=32,
+        )
+        QFP8 = (
+            make_fake_tensor(Float8E4M3FN, (M, q_cols), (q_cols, 1), assumed_align=32)
+            if key.has_qfp8
+            else None
+        )
+
+        return (
+            A,
+            B,
+            SFA,
+            SFB,
+            Q,
+            WQ,
+            WK,
+            WIQ,
+            WIK,
+            COS_SIN,
+            POS,
+            KVC,
+            IDXC,
+            SLOT,
+            IDX_SLOT,
+            IQFP8,
+            QFP8,
+            # runtime scalars (eps, q/k/v scales, grid): placeholder values
+            Float32(1e-6),
+            Float32(1.0),
+            Float32(1.0),
+            Float32(1.0),
+            148,
+        )

+@cache
+def _device_info(device: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """(SM count, L2 bytes) of a CUDA device."""
+    props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device)
+    return props.multi_processor_count, props.L2_cache_size

+
+def _group_m(weight_bytes: int, l2_bytes: int) -> int:
+    # Group M-tiles 16 at a time when the weight is a large fraction of L2, so
+    # a wave reads a few N-panels instead of all of B (GB300: helps TP1's 60MB
+    # weight by 1.5-5%; slows TP2 / TP4, whose weights stay L2-resident anyway)
+    return 16 if weight_bytes >= l2_bytes // 4 else 1
+
+
+def register_qkv_index_fused_epilogue_warmup(
+    *, has_q: bool, has_qfp8: bool, nkv: int, block_size: int, weight_bytes: int
+) -> None:
+    """Compile this layer's kernels (both tile configs) during JIT warmup."""
+    _, l2_bytes = _device_info(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    _JIT.register_warmup(
+        has_q=has_q,
+        has_qfp8=has_qfp8,
+        nkv=nkv,
+        block_size=block_size,
+        group_m=_group_m(weight_bytes, l2_bytes),
+    )

+    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""FlashInfer task-scheduled (``prims_ts``) paged decode.
+
+Wraps ``flashinfer.attention.prims_ts.BatchDecodePagedTSWrapper`` for uniform
+query-block decode: every request contributes exactly ``max_query_len`` query
+tokens over a paged KV cache. That is the DFlash/DSpark drafter shape, and the
+reason this backend exists is that ``mask_type="dense"`` expresses a
+*non-causal* draft block directly -- the trtllm-gen paged decode kernel is
+bottom-right causal and silently ignores a supplied mask.
+
+Layout. No KV cache change: K and V are the two halves of vLLM's ordinary
+``[pages, Hkv, page_size, 2 * D]`` page, so their token stride is ``2 * D``.
+The kernel builds its TMA descriptors from the tensors' own strides
+(``_validate_native_hnd_tma_strides``), so the only requirement is a
+contiguous head_dim. Verified numerically equal to the same data repacked
+into compact planes.
+
+Sliding window. ``prims_ts`` rejects ``window_left >= 0`` unless the mask is
+causal, so a non-causal windowed layer cannot be expressed directly. The query
+block always sits at the end of the sequence, so the symmetric window reduces
+to a suffix, and we hand the kernel a block table restricted to the window's
+pages (see :func:`_restrict_to_window`). Because the restriction is page
+aligned, each query token sees up to ``page_size - 1`` extra tokens at the old
+edge, and all query tokens share one window start rather than each having its
+own (``max_query_len - 1`` tokens of drift).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, ClassVar
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import (
+    AttentionBackend,
+    AttentionCGSupport,
+    AttentionImpl,
+    AttentionLayer,
+    AttentionMetadata,
+    AttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    AttentionType,
+    CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    MultipleOf,
+    max_decode_query_len,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec, KVCacheSpec
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config.cache import CacheDType
+    from vllm.platforms.interface import DeviceCapability
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# flashinfer/attention/prims_ts/decode.py: _SUPPORTED_PAGE_SIZES,
+# _SUPPORTED_HEAD_DIMS, _SUPPORTED_COMPUTE_CAPABILITIES. (10, 7) is SM107a /
+# Rubin, which the kernel additionally gates on a CuTe DSL that can emit for
+# the sm_100f family (>= 4.8, else CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_100f in the environment).
+_TS_PAGE_SIZES = (16, 32, 64, 128)
+_TS_HEAD_DIMS = (64, 128, 256)
+_TS_CAPABILITIES = ((10, 0), (10, 3), (10, 7))
+_TS_MAX_HEAD_RATIO = 128
+
+
+def _require_prims_ts():
+    """Import the prims_ts wrapper, or explain which flashinfer is needed.
+
+    0.7.0.post1 ships prims_ts but calls ``Task._run_task_body_impl`` with a
+    ``context`` kwarg that cutlass-dsl 4.8.0 removed, so it raises TypeError
+    deep inside kernel codegen.
+    """
+    try:
+        from flashinfer.attention.prims_ts import BatchDecodePagedTSWrapper
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "FLASHINFER_TS needs flashinfer-python>=0.7.1 "
+            "(flashinfer.attention.prims_ts is missing)."
+        ) from exc
+    import flashinfer
+
+    if tuple(int(p) for p in flashinfer.__version__.split(".")[:3]) < (0, 7, 1):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"FLASHINFER_TS needs flashinfer-python>=0.7.1, found "
+            f"{flashinfer.__version__}: earlier builds of prims_ts are "
+            "incompatible with cutlass-dsl>=4.8."
+        )
+    return BatchDecodePagedTSWrapper
+
+
+def _ts_output_dtype(q_dtype: torch.dtype, model_dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.dtype:
+    """The output dtype the kernel can write for this query dtype.
+
+    An FP8 query only yields FP16 or FP8 out, so a bf16 model stages through
+    FP16 and converts; every other combination writes the model dtype directly.
+    """
+    if q_dtype is torch.float8_e4m3fn and model_dtype is not torch.float16:
+        return torch.float16
+    return model_dtype
+
+
+def _kv_kernel_dtype(spec: AttentionSpec) -> torch.dtype:
+    """An FP8 cache is stored as uint8 and viewed as e4m3 at use."""
+    if spec.dtype is torch.uint8:
+        return current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+    return spec.dtype
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FlashInferTSMetadata(AttentionMetadata):
+    # Per-request K/V lengths the kernel reads, already restricted to the
+    # window when one applies.
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    # [B, C] int32 page ids, likewise restricted.
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    num_reqs: int
+    num_actual_tokens: int
+    query_len: int
+    # Plan bound at build time; the same object must be replayed by a captured
+    # graph, which is why plans are keyed only on (batch size, query length).
+    wrapper: Any
+
+
+class FlashInferTSMetadataBuilder(AttentionMetadataBuilder[FlashInferTSMetadata]):
+    _cudagraph_support: ClassVar[AttentionCGSupport] = AttentionCGSupport.UNIFORM_BATCH
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kv_cache_spec: KVCacheSpec,
+        layer_names: list[str],
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        assert isinstance(kv_cache_spec, AttentionSpec)
+        self.page_size = kv_cache_spec.block_size
+        self.num_kv_heads = kv_cache_spec.num_kv_heads
+        self.head_size = kv_cache_spec.head_size
+        # Q and K/V dtypes are kept matched: FP8 query against the FP8 cache,
+        # or model-dtype against an unquantized one. The FP8 query is produced
+        # upstream (MiniMax-M3's fused QK-norm/RoPE kernel writes it through
+        # q_fp8_out), so the attention layer does not quantize it again.
+        self.kv_dtype = _kv_kernel_dtype(kv_cache_spec)
+        self.q_dtype = self.kv_dtype
+        self.out_dtype = vllm_config.model_config.dtype
+        self.num_qo_heads = vllm_config.model_config.get_num_attention_heads(
+            vllm_config.parallel_config
+        )
+        # FullAttentionSpec records the window when the hybrid KV cache manager
+        # is disabled; SlidingWindowSpec carries it directly.
+        self.sliding_window: int | None = getattr(kv_cache_spec, "sliding_window", None)
+        self.query_len = max_decode_query_len(vllm_config)
+        self._plans: dict[tuple[int, int, bool], Any] = {}
+        self._init_reorder_batch_threshold(1, supports_spec_as_decode=True)
+
+        # CUDA-graph-safe metadata. This builder advertises UNIFORM_BATCH, so
+        # the drafter's attention is captured and replayed; the kernel records
+        # the ADDRESS of seq_lens and the page table at capture time. Building
+        # fresh tensors per step would leave a replayed graph reading freed
+        # memory, so every build writes into these buffers in place.
+        max_reqs = max(
+            vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs,
+            vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
+            // max(self.query_len, 1),
+        )
+        self._buf_seq_lens = torch.zeros(max_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self._buf_block_table = torch.zeros(
+            (max_reqs, self._window_pages(self.query_len)),
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device=device,
+        )
+
+    def _window_pages(self, query_len: int) -> int:
+        """Page-table width a restricted (windowed) batch needs."""
+        if self.sliding_window is None:
+            return cdiv(self.vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len, self.page_size)
+        return cdiv(self.sliding_window + query_len - 1, self.page_size) + 1
+
+    def _max_kv_len(self) -> int:
+        """Constant K/V capacity every plan compiles for.
+
+        Keeping it constant is what makes one plan per (batch size, query
+        length) safe to replay from a CUDA graph: ``build()`` can never pick a
+        differently-compiled plan for a batch the graph already captured.
+        """
+        if self.sliding_window is not None:
+            # _restrict_to_window leaves at most one partial page in front of
+            # the window plus the query block itself.
+            return self.sliding_window + self.query_len + self.page_size
+        return self.vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+
+    def _get_plan(self, num_reqs: int, query_len: int, causal: bool) -> Any:
+        key = (num_reqs, query_len, causal)
+        plan = self._plans.get(key)
+        if plan is not None:
+            return plan
+
+        BatchDecodePagedTSWrapper = _require_prims_ts()
+
+        window = self.sliding_window
+        wrapper = BatchDecodePagedTSWrapper(kv_layout="HND")
+        wrapper.plan(
+            device=self.device,
+            batch_size=num_reqs,
+            num_qo_heads=self.num_qo_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            head_dim=self.head_size,
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+            max_kv_len=self._max_kv_len(),
+            max_seq_len_q=query_len,
+            packed_query=False,
+            q_data_type=self.q_dtype,
+            kv_data_type=self.kv_dtype,
+            o_data_type=_ts_output_dtype(self.q_dtype, self.out_dtype),
+            # A dense plan is what makes a non-causal draft block expressible;
+            # it cannot carry a window, which _restrict_to_window applies to
+            # the page table instead.
+            mask_type="causal" if causal else "dense",
+            window_left=window - 1 if (causal and window is not None) else -1,
+        )
+        self._plans[key] = wrapper
+        return wrapper
+
+    def _restrict_to_window(
+        self, seq_lens: torch.Tensor, block_table: torch.Tensor, query_len: int
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Cut the page table down to the pages the window can reach.
+
+        The query block ends the sequence, so a symmetric window around it is
+        the suffix ``[L - w - query_len + 1, L)``. Round that start down to a
+        page so the slice is expressible as a page table, then renumber the
+        lengths relative to the new first page.
+        """
+        assert self.sliding_window is not None
+        span = self.sliding_window + query_len - 1
+        num_pages = self._buf_block_table.shape[1]
+        num_reqs = seq_lens.shape[0]
+
+        start_page = torch.clamp_min(
+            (seq_lens - span).div(self.page_size, rounding_mode="floor"), 0
+        )
+        cols = torch.arange(num_pages, device=block_table.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        idx = start_page.unsqueeze(1).to(torch.int64) + cols.unsqueeze(0)
+        idx = idx.clamp_max(block_table.shape[1] - 1)
+
+        assert num_reqs <= self._buf_seq_lens.shape[0], (
+            f"FLASHINFER_TS metadata buffer holds {self._buf_seq_lens.shape[0]} "
+            f"requests, got {num_reqs}"
+        )
+        out_lens = self._buf_seq_lens[:num_reqs]
+        out_table = self._buf_block_table[:num_reqs]
+        out_lens.copy_(seq_lens - start_page.to(seq_lens.dtype) * self.page_size)
+        out_table.copy_(block_table.gather(1, idx))
+        return out_lens, out_table
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> FlashInferTSMetadata:
+        num_reqs = common_attn_metadata.num_reqs
+        num_tokens = common_attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
+        causal = common_attn_metadata.causal
+        if isinstance(causal, torch.Tensor):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "FLASHINFER_TS has no per-sequence causality; it plans one "
+                "mask for the whole batch."
+            )
+        # The drafter contributes the same number of query tokens per request,
+        # so the block length is the quotient; max_query_len is only an upper
+        # bound. Startup profiling also builds ragged batches that no real
+        # draft step produces (e.g. 5 tokens over 2 requests). Rounding down
+        # covers a whole number of blocks and leaves the remainder untouched,
+        # which keeps those builds in bounds instead of failing the engine.
+        query_len = num_tokens // num_reqs if num_reqs else 0
+        num_tokens = num_reqs * query_len
+        # The model runner builds metadata for every KV cache group on every
+        # batch, so this is also called with the target's prefill shapes for
+        # the drafter's own group -- metadata the speculator never uses, since
+        # it builds its own. A drafter block is never longer than
+        # max_decode_query_len, so anything wider is not a batch this backend
+        # runs; planning it would compile a prefill-shaped plan and fail
+        # validation (seq_len_q > max_kv_len).
+        if query_len > self.query_len:
+            query_len = 0
+
+        seq_lens = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens[:num_reqs]
+        block_table = common_attn_metadata.block_table_tensor[:num_reqs]
+        if self.sliding_window is not None and not causal:
+            seq_lens, block_table = self._restrict_to_window(
+                seq_lens, block_table, query_len
+            )
+        else:
+            num_pages = min(block_table.shape[1], self._buf_block_table.shape[1])
+            out_lens = self._buf_seq_lens[:num_reqs]
+            out_table = self._buf_block_table[:num_reqs, :num_pages]
+            out_lens.copy_(seq_lens)
+            out_table.copy_(block_table[:, :num_pages])
+            seq_lens, block_table = out_lens, out_table
+
+        if query_len == 0:
+            return FlashInferTSMetadata(
+                seq_lens=common_attn_metadata.seq_lens[:num_reqs],
+                block_table=common_attn_metadata.block_table_tensor[:num_reqs],
+                num_reqs=num_reqs,
+                num_actual_tokens=0,
+                query_len=0,
+                wrapper=None,
+            )
+
+        return FlashInferTSMetadata(
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            block_table=block_table,
+            num_reqs=num_reqs,
+            num_actual_tokens=num_tokens,
+            query_len=query_len,
+            wrapper=self._get_plan(num_reqs, query_len, causal),
+        )
+
+
+class FlashInferTSImpl(AttentionImpl[FlashInferTSMetadata]):
+    forward_includes_kv_cache_update: bool = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        num_heads: int,
+        head_size: int,
+        scale: float,
+        num_kv_heads: int | None = None,
+        alibi_slopes: list[float] | None = None,
+        sliding_window: int | None = None,
+        kv_cache_dtype: str = "auto",
+        logits_soft_cap: float | None = None,
+        attn_type: str = AttentionType.DECODER,
+        kv_sharing_target_layer_name: str | None = None,
+        sinks: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if sinks is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("FLASHINFER_TS does not support attention sinks.")
+        if alibi_slopes is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("FLASHINFER_TS does not support alibi.")
+        if logits_soft_cap:
+            raise NotImplementedError("FLASHINFER_TS does not support softcap.")
+        if kv_sharing_target_layer_name is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("FLASHINFER_TS does not support KV sharing.")
+        if attn_type != AttentionType.DECODER:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                f"FLASHINFER_TS does not support attention type {attn_type}."
+            )
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        self.head_size = head_size
+        self.scale = float(scale)
+        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads or num_heads
+        self.sliding_window = sliding_window

+def parse_hugepage_size(value: object) -> int | None:
+    """Parse ``cpu_hugepage_block_size``; ``None``/``""``/``"none"`` disable it."""
+    key = str(value or "none").strip().upper().replace("IB", "B")
+    key = {"2M": "2MB", "1G": "1GB"}.get(key, key)
+    if key == "NONE":
+        return None
+    if key not in HUGEPAGE_SIZES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Unsupported cpu_hugepage_block_size {value!r}; "
+            f"expected one of {sorted(HUGEPAGE_SIZES)} or none"
+        )
+    return HUGEPAGE_SIZES[key]
+

+        numa_node: int | None = None,
